results.description: A spacious Victorian four-bedroom semi-detached residence offering flexible living spaces spread over 4 floors. An excellent opportunity for those seeking the grandeur of the past with generous room sizes and a large private garden providing a perfect chance to put your own stamp on a substantial family property. -[ABOUT YOUR NEW HOME]- Arriving at the quieter end of Trinity Road surrounded by other similar sized residential properties, you'll find the house sits proudly amongst its neighbours with a neatly paved frontage surrounded by colourful planted beds and foliage, a path way and steps on the left lead you to the front door. A long sloping driveway to the right side of the property gives private off street parking and a welcoming feel as you arrive home. When you step into the property, you'll find a home that has been tenderly cared for in the years gone by giving you an excellent base from which to modernise or inject your personality. Stepping through the front door, you arrive into the entrance porch. This is a practical and welcoming space where coats and shoes can be stored before you move into the main living areas of the home. Through the internal doorway you enter a grand and high ceilinged hallway with the staircase rising to the first floor on the right, a doorway to the immediate right leads through to the front reception space. The sheer scale of this wonderful room introduces you to the proportions this house has to offer and is currently used for family dining. Open invitation as this room will easily house even the largest of family groups. Tall bay windows looking out the the road allow natural light to fill the room while offering a pleasant outlook towards the world beyond, helping the whole space feel bright and open throughout the day. Back through the hallway and to the rear of the home you find the ground floor sitting room. This room offers an open yet cosy space in which to configure your lounge furniture however you would like around the focal point of the fireplace, a perfect spot for TV/film nights with the family and unwinding at the end of the day. Tall glazed patio doors flood the room with natural light and open onto a raised external balcony area with steps leading down to the garden from which you can sit and survey the grounds beyond directly overlooking a large pond area and mature greenery behind. Through an arch way in the living room you will find the heart of the home, a large and practical dining/kitchen space with a feature brick fireplace and fresh modern cabinetry providing large swathes of preparation space and storage. The sink area overlooks the garden and trees at the rear and large windows keep the space bright. The arrangement allows you to move comfortably between the cooking, preparation and washing areas, which helps the space feel functional for everyday use whether it is supervising homework tasks, family breakfasts or informal social gatherings. Back through into the hallway and past the staircase there is a handy ground floor modern shower room and w/c. A door leads to a further staircase down to the cellar rooms at this property. The first you encounter at the rear of the home is another large living room with huge patio doors leading directly onto a patio and the garden at ground level. A perfect setting for a cinema room or child's play room/teenagers hangout room, the possibilities are endless. A wonderful surprise is the huge games room and purpose built bar area great for entertaining and relaxing. There is also a large workshop/store room and access to the garage space which is big enough to hold multiple cars and provides connection from the driveway into the rear grounds. Back upstairs and up to the first landing where you find a luxurious and expansive bathroom complete with a freestanding sleek modern bath and double shower together with w/c and vanity suite. Neutral tiling keeps the space calm and spa-like, a true sanctuary in which to light some candles whilst you relax in the tub. Also on this landing is a built-in cupboard for storage and another small room in which you can store bedding and linen where the boiler is also located. Up another few steps and the main family bedrooms spill out from the open landing. These 3 bedrooms do not disappoint and continue the theme of huge open airy rooms found on the ground floor. The master bedroom has fitted wardrobes and room for all the furniture you could wish to arrange. A wide bay window allows natural light to fill the room, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere throughout the day. The proportions here make it easy for you to imagine this becoming a calm and comfortable principal bedroom with plenty of room to personalise the space. Next to this is a narrower room perfect for a single occupancy and a further large double room sits comfortably at the rear. With a pleasant outlook over the garden, this room enjoys a quieter position within the home and would work perfectly as a guest bedroom, a teenager's room, or even a spacious home office for those working remotely. The fourth bedroom is located at the top of the house in the attic space , another large double room beneath the rafters enjoying the benefit of a personal walk in wardrobe. Stepping out from the rear of the home, you are welcomed into a extra generous garden that stretches comfortably away from the house, offering a lovely sense of space. The grounds stretch almost as far as you can see bordered by mature trees providing shade and privacy in some areas with a grand monkey puzzle tree featured at the centre. A blank canvas for avid gardeners, room for a vegetable patch perhaps or swing sets and trampolines for the kids. The garden is mainly laid to lawn, creating a versatile outdoor space that can easily adapt to a variety of lifestyles. Whether you imagine children playing on the grass, setting up outdoor seating for summer evenings. The balcony at first floor level looks out over the large pond area and patio. With its length, greenery, and peaceful atmosphere, it provides a wonderful extension of the home where you can enjoy the outdoors, entertain guests, or simply unwind at the end of the day. -[LIVING ON TRINITY ROAD]- Trinity Road is located in the heart of Bootle. It benefits from good transport links, with nearby access to local bus routes and train stations that connect residents to Liverpool city centre and surrounding areas. This makes it a practical location for commuters as well as families. For those that love being outdoors, there are several local green spaces including King's Garden and South Park are both nearby. Walton Hall Park is a little further beyond and is also a popular choice. The closest train stations are Bootle Oriel Road and Kirkdale, both offering frequent services ensuring you can easily get around. Liverpool City centre is also a short drive/commute away, here you can enjoy a wealth of shops, restaurants and other amenities for your convenience. Tiled flooring and splashbacks, along with a feature exposed brick arch, lead seamlessly into the dining room. Features a UPVC double glazed window. Features UPVC double glazed doors and a radiator. Includes a TV point, radiator, and UPVC double glazed window. Reception Room Two 4.72m x 2.85m (15'5" x 9'4") Currently utilised as a formal dining room, this versatile space can be adapted to suit various needs. Sophisticated fitted wardrobes and a dressing table with drawers span two walls, with the bed comfortably positioned as the room's focal point. Features a radiator and UPVC double glazed window. Front Bedroom Three 3.58m x 2.91m (11'8" x 9'6") Another generously sized double bedroom, perfect for a family home. Features a radiator and UPVC double glazed window. Includes a mirrored cabinet, heated towel rail, and a UPVC obscured double glazed window. This wonderful family home offers a beautiful outdoor space to be proud of and enjoy. Externally, the property benefits from a good-sized SOUTH-FACING REAR GARDEN with a sunny aspect, ideal for families and outdoor entertaining. To the side there is a DETACHED GARAGE, together with driveway parking. Situated in a sought-after residential location close to the PINEWOODS and coastal walks, this is very much a blank canvas with strong fundamentals in place. results.location: Catharine Street, Georgian Quarter, Liverpool, Merseyside, L8 7NL
results.summary: Agent ID: MM1451 Refined Georgian grandeur embraces exquisite modern restoration in this exceptional five-storey, four-bedroom end-terraced residence, enviably positioned on Catharine Street in one of Liverpool’s most coveted addresses, the distinguished and historic Georgian Quarter. A truly exceptional example of enhanced period living, this beautifully proportioned and impeccably presented home showcases thoughtfully curated accommodation, combining timeless classical elegance and sophisticated contemporary enhancements to appeal to even the most discerning of tastes. Liverpool’s Georgian Quarter is renowned for its abundant architectural heritage, cobbled streets and cultural hotspots, boasting an array of fine restaurants, fashionable bars and an iconic theatre scene. Think exuberant evenings at the Philharmonic, or perhaps dinner at The Quarter restaurant, this marvellous property is perfectly positioned in close reach to the array of exciting amenities that this vibrant neighbourhood presents. The attractions of Liverpool City Centre are also just a short walk away. Conveniently located for academics and medical professionals, this undeniably impressive home is also nestled within short walking distance of both the University of Liverpool and Royal Liverpool University Hospital. Equally suited for businesspeople, a strong network of transport links is just on your doorstep, with both Liverpool Central and Liverpool Lime Street stations in close proximity. Liverpool John Lennon airport is also within just 7 miles reach. Upon entering this elegant residence, you are firstly welcomed by a striking foyer laid with cool monochrome tiling, setting a refined first impression. This flows effortlessly into the imposing hallway, bursting with colour and a seamless blend of neutral and mustard tones. It’s a welcoming debut to the stylish and vibrant interiors this home has to offer. You will also notice the property occupies a prominent end-position, allowing for a wealth of natural light to cascade into both the hallway and across the multiple floors, enhancing the sense of space and elevating the home’s bright, airy ambience. From here, the front reception room is first revealed, showcasing classic Georgian high ceilings and elegant bay windows. Beautifully proportioned and effortlessly versatile, it offers a refined yet functional setting that’s ideally suited to everyday living. Continuing to the rear of the ground floor, you’ll discover the beautifully curated principal living room, brimming with character. Featuring elegant alcove detailing, stylish Venetian shutters, and a welcoming log burner, it offers a warm and inviting retreat for year-round relaxation and comfort. The majestic staircase, gracefully positioned at the centre of the home, provides a sense of balance and symmetry to the diverse living spaces. Descending to the lower-ground level, you arrive at the heart of the residence, the beautifully maintained and thoughtfully designed kitchen. Boasting a central island, shaker-style units, modern integrated appliances and a recessed cooking area, it marries contemporary finishes with warm, homely touches and offers the perfect functional setting for both cooking and entertaining family and guests alike. The kitchen also opens seamlessly onto the idyllic split-level rear courtyard, creating an effortless indoor-outdoor flow. West to south-west facing in orientation, the courtyard enjoys abundant sunlight and also provides generous space for outdoor seating, making it an ideal setting for al-fresco dining or hosting summer gatherings. The lower ground floor also provides a spacious formal dining room; a refined and inviting setting that’s ideally suited for both family meals and special occasions. It also offers access to a small exposed-brick cellar space, ideal for your storage needs. A sleek WC completes the lower ground floor. Arriving to the third storey of this expansive property, we are welcomed to the current principal bedroom. With two charming sash windows, it’s bathed in natural light, creating a serene and inviting atmosphere that’s perfect for both starting and ending your day. The exceptional master bathroom delivers a truly luxurious, spa-inspired experience. results.summary: A second floor one bedroom retirement apartment for sale within Retirement Security's Priory Court, a retirement development in Huyton, L36. The apartment comprises an entrance hallway with fitted storage, fitted kitchen with a new integrated fridge freezer, light and bright living room with two large windows and electric fire, master bedroom with bay window and large wardrobe plus extra storage, walk in wet room with level access newly fitted shower and extractor fan. On the outskirts of the pleasant village of Huyton, Priory Court is an independent retirement setting of 44 spacious apartments and a collection of bright communal spaces, all at your disposal. Bask in the luxuries of a higher-service retirement development with 24-hour staff who are always on site and available to help and support you wherever needed. There is also a trustworthy team of Housekeeping Assistants who look after all shared spaces, and complete a weekly 90 minute cleaning of your dwelling! Relax in the Owner’s Lounge and catch up with familiar faces over a morning coffee or afternoon tea and take part in the lively social schedule the Court offers: from films, scheduled speakers, musical entertainment, and armchair yoga classes to quizzes and raffles, there is always something to get involved with. The Owner’s Dining Room is the perfect place to unwind over a warming 3-course meal that is prepared fresh and in-house, with popular bacon and sausage butties being served for breakfast on most Tuesdays. Unwind in the Hobbies Room, a quieter space where you can enjoy a variety of past times like arts and crafts, cards, board games and whist. Priory Court is surrounded by vibrant greenery, with trees sheltering you from the surrounding area, and plants beautifully positioned around the grounds. Providing a unique approach to independent retirement living, Retirement Security was established in 1983. We have continued to trail blaze for over 40 years with 32 Courts across England and Wales all offering a range of high-level services to make life easier. Our founder, Bob Bessell, committed to provide retirees with a wider selection of retirement options, ones that offered affordability, a secure environment and a supportive community, alongside retaining financial control – Courts ‘Run by Owners, for Owners’. These carefully designed properties bridge the gap between luxury retirement living and preserving your independence for as long as possible. It is important to note that a significant proportion of the Service Charge relates to items which the prospective purchaser is responsible for in their present home, such as building insurance, building maintenance, gardening, and domestic help. The lease provides that a transfer premium is payable to Retirement Security on resale of a property. The maximum premium payable is 3% of the sale price depending on the length of time an Owner has lived at the property. Further information is available from the Court Manager. The remaining bedrooms are all doubles, one of which also has a kitchenette, suitable for a range of tenant profiles. A communal bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms, while a shared kitchen forms the hub of the property. The kitchen includes both a dining space and a breakfast area, offering residents a designated place to prepare and enjoy meals, as well as to socialise. There are no separate reception rooms, with the kitchen/dining area functioning as the main communal space. The property holds an **EPC rating of D** and falls within **Council Tax band C**. Located in Liverpool, the property benefits from local public transport links and nearby schools. The area is served by regular bus routes connecting into Liverpool city centre, providing access to the city’s commercial, retail and leisure amenities, as well as its universities and major employment hubs. Mainline rail services from Liverpool Lime Street offer onward connections to destinations such as Manchester, London and other key regional centres, making the wider location attractive to a broad tenant base including professionals and students who require easy access to the city and beyond. Liverpool’s wider leisure offering includes parks, cultural venues, restaurants, cafés and sports facilities, all contributing to the overall attractiveness of the city as a place to live and work, and supporting long-term demand for well-located HMO accommodation. This fully let six-bedroom HMO is therefore positioned as an investment opportunity, particularly **ideal for investors** seeking a property with an existing rental structure and company let in place. This property is **for sale by Modern Method of Auction**, allowing the buyer and seller to complete within a 56-day Reservation Period. Services may be recommended by the Agent/Auctioneer, from which they may receive payment of up to £960 including VAT if taken; these services are optional. For information on broadband or mobile coverage in the area, please visit checker.ofcom.org.uk. The building also benefits from lift access to all floors and a secure entry system for added convenience and security. Situated on Rumford Street, the property is within easy walking distance of Moorfields and James Street stations, providing excellent connectivity. The Liverpool waterfront, Liverpool ONE shopping district and a wide range of restaurants, bars and leisure amenities are all close by, making this an ideal location for tenants. As rental demand continues to rise and long term growth prospects remain strong across the North West, Liverpool presents an attractive opportunity for investors seeking both consistent rental income and future capital appreciation. This property offers a rare combination of character, location and strong rental appeal within a well established and sought after part of the city. results.summary: The Open House Is Now Full - All Enquiries Will Go On The Reservation List. Offered to the market for the first time in over a century, Lilac Cottage, built in the late 1890s, is a truly remarkable home, rich in local history. Originally a cottage for farm workers, the property later served as Melling’s doctor’s surgery in the early 1960s. It has remained within the same family throughout, representing a rare and meaningful legacy that is now ready to begin its next chapter. Full of character and charm, Lilac Cottage offers a wonderful opportunity to own a piece of the village’s heritage. Properties of this nature seldom become available, combining period features, a rich backstory, and the potential to create a truly special home. Situated in the heart of Melling, the property enjoys a peaceful setting while remaining well-connected to nearby amenities and transport links. Whether you are drawn by its history, its individuality, or the opportunity it presents, Lilac Cottage is a home that simply cannot be replicated. Set on a plot unlike any other in Melling, the property enjoys far-reaching views that have become increasingly rare following recent development within the area. Positioned beside the village Church, the land to the rear is owned by the Church itself - which notably declined the opportunity to sell during the construction of the nearby new-build estate. This offers a rare sense of long-term security, preserving the open fields behind and ensuring the outlook remains unchanged for years to come. Set back from the road, Lilac Cottage enjoys a private position, benefiting from not being overlooked to the side due to the presence of large, mature trees, which provide privacy without restricting the natural sunlight. A south-facing garden sits to the side, ideal for enjoying the sun throughout the day. To the front, there is scope to adapt the space, with potential to utilise part of the garden to create a four-car driveway, with the option of adding a wall behind to further enhance privacy. Alternatively, for those not looking to extend, the property already benefits from a driveway that runs all the way down to the double garage itself. Beyond this, a hidden garden can be found behind the double garage, offering views across the fields. The setting reflects a traditional village feel, with potential for a vegetable patch; the current owner also had a pond there. The possibilities are endless. The double garage itself is generous in size, with one electric door. Inside, it has been carefully organised by the current owners, creating a practical and well-kept space - a true testament to the way the home has been maintained. The home offers undeniable kerb appeal. From the front, the original property is the epitome of cottage charm, featuring diamond leaded windows, a convenient porch, and a well-kept front garden. There are three main access points, with the current owners typically entering via the kitchen door, located towards the rear of the home. Stepping through the stable door, you are welcomed into the kitchen, where stunning parquet flooring immediately stands out. The property is presented in move-in-ready condition, allowing a buyer to comfortably live in the home while carrying out any desired updates over time. Many may consider extending or reconfiguring to create a larger kitchen space, although the existing kitchen remains in excellent order as it stands. To the rear, the home continues into the scullery - what would now commonly be used as a utility room - enjoying pleasant views of the outdoors. These rooms were added during the 1960s, blending practicality with the home’s evolving history. Moving through into the hallway and original part of the home, you are met with a natural flow of rooms, reflecting the character and layout of a property from this period. As reflected on the floorplan, the current owners still refer to the rooms by their original names from when the property served as the village doctor’s surgery. Entering through the original front door, you are welcomed into what was once the “Waiting Room”, which leads through to “The Surgery”, where the original flue remains in place, offering potential for a log burner, should a buyer wish to incorporate one. Continuing through, you are then met with “The Dispensary”, further highlighting the home’s unique and historic past. The surgery itself houses the original staircase, which rises to the first floor, where you will find two well-proportioned bedrooms. The upstairs remains quaint and in keeping with the traditional style of the property. The boiler is relatively modern; however, the current owners have removed the radiators to prevent any potential damage while the property remains unoccupied. The roof of the original part of the home was replaced approximately two years ago. There is clear potential for those looking to reconfigure or extend, whether that be creating larger rooms downstairs or enhancing the upstairs to incorporate a more substantial principal bedroom and bathroom. The possibilities are extensive. That said, the true beauty of Lilac Cottage is its versatility - it can be thoroughly enjoyed exactly as it is, while still offering the opportunity to evolve into a stunning long-term family home. If you need to sell your property to purchase, you can’t deny that this marketing is the best in the marketplace. We can arrange to market your home to this level with no trouble. Ask to speak with Mia directly when you arrange your viewing. This property is known to be freehold. No Chain This property is known to have no development happening at the rear. This property is in Council Tax Band C. Set back from the road, Lilac Cottage enjoys a private position, benefiting from not being overlooked to the side due to the presence of large, mature trees, which provide privacy without restricting the natural sunlight. A south-facing garden sits to the side, ideal for enjoying the sun throughout the day. To the front, there is scope to adapt the space, with potential to utilise part of the garden to create a four-car driveway, with the option of adding a wall behind to further enhance privacy. Alternatively, for those not looking to extend, the property already benefits from a driveway that runs all the way down to the double garage itself. Beyond this, a hidden garden can be found behind the double garage, offering views across the fields. The setting reflects a traditional village feel, with potential for a vegetable patch; the current owner also had a pond there. The possibilities are endless. The double garage itself is generous in size, with one electric door. Inside, it has been carefully organised by the current owners, creating a practical and well-kept space - a true testament to the way the home has been maintained. The home offers undeniable kerb appeal. From the front, the original property is the epitome of cottage charm, featuring diamond leaded windows, a convenient porch, and a well-kept front garden. There are three main access points, with the current owners typically entering via the kitchen door, located towards the rear of the home. Stepping through the stable door, you are welcomed into the kitchen, where stunning parquet flooring immediately stands out. The property is presented in move-in-ready condition, allowing a buyer to comfortably live in the home while carrying out any desired updates over time. Many may consider extending or reconfiguring to create a larger kitchen space, although the existing kitchen remains in excellent order as it stands. To the rear, the home continues into the scullery - what would now commonly be used as a utility room - enjoying pleasant views of the outdoors. These rooms were added during the 1960s, blending practicality with the home’s evolving history. Moving through into the hallway and original part of the home, you are met with a natural flow of rooms, reflecting the character and layout of a property from this period. As reflected on the floorplan, the current owners still refer to the rooms by their original names from when the property served as the village doctor’s surgery. Entering through the original front door, you are welcomed into what was once the “Waiting Room”, which leads through to “The Surgery”, where the original flue remains in place, offering potential for a log burner, should a buyer wish to incorporate one. Continuing through, you are then met with “The Dispensary”, further highlighting the home’s unique and historic past. The surgery itself houses the original staircase, which rises to the first floor, where you will find two well-proportioned bedrooms. The upstairs remains quaint and in keeping with the traditional style of the property. The boiler is relatively modern; however, the current owners have removed the radiators to prevent any potential damage while the property remains unoccupied. The roof of the original part of the home was replaced approximately two years ago. There is clear potential for those looking to reconfigure or extend, whether that be creating larger rooms downstairs or enhancing the upstairs to incorporate a more substantial principal bedroom and bathroom. The possibilities are extensive. That said, the true beauty of Lilac Cottage is its versatility - it can be thoroughly enjoyed exactly as it is, while still offering the opportunity to evolve into a stunning long-term family home. results.summary: History Meets Modern Living in the Heart of Woolton Village History Meets Modern Living in the Heart of Woolton Village Tucked away on the picture-perfect Quarry Street, this stunning two-bedroom duplex apartment offers something truly special — a blend of historic charm, contemporary style, and untapped potential. Once home to Woolton’s Police Station and Magistrates Court, this landmark building dates back to 1873 and has since been thoughtfully transformed into a collection of unique homes. Step inside this particular apartment and you’ll feel that sense of history — elevated with modern upgrades and smart design. The heart of the home unfolds across two light-filled levels. Downstairs, a welcoming entrance hall sets the tone — currently styled as a relaxed reading space, but easily reimagined as a home office or creative corner. The split-level layout creates natural flow, with a bright and airy living room and dining area perfect for both everyday lounging and entertaining friends. The separate kitchen is sleek, practical, and filled with character. Upstairs, two generously sized double bedrooms let the light pour in through Velux windows, served by a stylish family bathroom. But the real surprise? A large loft space just waiting to be transformed — whether you dream of a third bedroom, a tucked-away office, or your own creative studio, the potential is already there. And speaking of upgrades — the owners have recently fitted bespoke hard-timber double-glazed windows (2024) throughout, enhancing both the aesthetic and the energy efficiency of the home. These handcrafted windows frame beautiful open views across South Liverpool, making every room feel warm, bright and full of life. Set in the heart of Woolton Village — one of Liverpool’s most sought-after neighbourhoods — you’re just a short stroll from cosy cafés, independent shops, leafy parks, and iconic local landmarks. This is more than just a home — it’s a lifestyle, wrapped in character and full of possibilities. If you’re looking for a home with soul, space, and room to grow — this is the one. results.summary: An exceptional opportunity to acquire this extended and immaculately presented semi-detached home on Knowsley Lane, Prescot, perfectly suited to modern family living. This stylish three-bedroom property has been thoughtfully enhanced to create a superb balance of space, practicality, and contemporary design, with high-quality finishes evident throughout. At the heart of the home lies the truly impressive extended open-plan living space to the rear, a standout feature that effortlessly caters to both everyday living and entertaining. This stunning area is intelligently zoned, incorporating a sleek modern fitted kitchen set beneath a striking pitched roof with large Velux windows that flood the space with natural light, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. The kitchen flows seamlessly into a defined dining area and a comfortable living space, where French doors open out onto the garden, further enhancing the sense of space and connection to the outdoors. To the first floor, the property continues to impress with three well-proportioned bedrooms and a beautifully appointed four-piece family bathroom, designed with both style and comfort in mind. results.summary: Discover charm and modern comfort in this beautifully presented two-bedroom cottage on Waddicar Lane, Melling, offering a delightful blend of traditional style and contemporary living spaces, this is a wonderful quirky home. The private garden offers many areas to entertain and enjoy the outdoors, combine this with the off-road parking and you have a wonderful opportunity not to be missed. Close to local amenities. Porch 1.55m x 0.92m (5'1" x 3'0") Walk into this original farmers' cottage through the composite door and into a convenient porch with wall light and UPVC double glazed windows. A wooden door with glass panel takes you into the lounge. Lounge 4.71m x 4.3m (15'5" x 14'1") A beautifully presented lounge with feature floor to ceiling, exposed brick decorative fireplace with stone hearth. The cottage feeling runs throughout this home with quirky features reminiscent of an old style cottage. Open stairs with under alcove area. UPVC double glazed window. A cupboard housing the electric meter and another for the gas meter. Radiator Kitchen/Diner 4.89m x 3.16m (16'0" x 10'4") This extended kitchen is well designed with an array of storage and perfectly presented. Country cream shaker style base and wall units, complemented with wooden surfaces, continue the cottage feel throughout this home whilst black, angled tiles provide a modern touch. Stainless steel sink and drainer with chrome mixer tap under the window providing views of the garden. Electric oven and 4 ring gas hob with extractor hood. Brand new 'Worcester' boiler. Space for a washing machine and fridge freezer. Generous space for a dining table and chairs. UPVC double glazed window and door and radiator. Landing Up the stairs and onto the landing which has doors to various rooms and loft access. Front Bedroom One 3.51m x 3.01m (11'6" x 9'10") A great first bedroom with ample storage in the fitted wardrobes. UPVC double glazed window and radiator. Rear Bedroom Two 3.23m x 2.2m (10'7" x 7'2") A second double bedroom with views of the garden. UPVC double glazed window and radiator. Bathroom 2.3m x 1.45m (7'6" x 4'9") A large shower enclosure with mains shower is the feature of this room and is complemented with a vanity sink unit and mixer tap, WC and heated towel rail. Spotlights finish the look. Rear Garden The rear garden is a delight and the perfect place to entertain with friends and family or just make the most of the sunshine. A decked area leads onto a lawned garden and then a further flagged patio area. Gate to neighbouring garden for access. Front Aspect This well presented cottage benefits from a flagged drive with off road parking. results.summary: A bright and impressive two bedroom second floor apartment on the popular Windermere Terrace, L8.(bordering Aigburth). Offering a generous open plan living and dining space, a modern fitted kitchen with all modern appliances, two well-proportioned bedrooms and a contemporary bathroom. This home suits a wide range of buyers. Additional features include luxury vinyl flooring and a large lounge window which floods the lounge with natural light and has beautiful views over the garden and part of Princes Park lake. The building itself is rich in character, forming part of the original Bellerive school which was newly developed 6 years ago Outside there is a well maintained, peaceful, garden area, which borders Princes Park lake. A peaceful residential street, with 5 minutes walking distance to Lark Lane and Sefton Park. A short 5-10 minute bus ride to the Georgian quarter and city centre. For cyclists, a short cycle through Princes Park and along Princes Road cycle path brings you to the Georgian Quarter. Plenty of green spaces from the door step. Set on the second floor of a well-kept residential building, this impressive two bedroom apartment on Windermere Terrace, L8 offers generous living space and a layout that will appeal to a wide range of buyers — from first-time purchasers to those seeking a larger, more comfortable apartment in a thriving city fringe location. The development enjoys an enviable position with Princes Park and Lark Lane right on the doorstep, providing immediate access to beautiful green space, independent cafés, restaurants and a vibrant cultural scene. The building itself is rich in character, forming part of the former Bellerive School, a feature that lends the development a unique sense of history and charm. It is also particularly well suited to those downsizing from a house, with several residents — including the current owner — having made the same transition. Converted and newly developed around five years ago, the apartment is ready to move straight into, requiring no further work. The interior features luxury vinyl flooring for both style and practicality, while a large window in the main living area floods the space with natural light and offers impressive views. The property opens into a spacious hallway that sets the tone for the generous proportions throughout. At the heart of the home is a bright and expansive open plan kitchen, living and dining area, designed for modern living with clearly defined zones for relaxing, dining and entertaining. The kitchen is fully equipped with integrated appliances, including a dishwasher and washer dryer, ensuring convenience from day one. Both bedrooms are well-proportioned, with the principal bedroom offering a notably generous footprint. The second bedroom is versatile and can comfortably accommodate a small double bed, making it ideal as a guest room, home office or nursery. A contemporary bathroom sits off the hallway, finished in a clean, neutral style to suit a variety of tastes. Practicality is further enhanced by inhouse storage, including the electric heater cupboard, with ample space for buyers to add additional storage solutions if desired. Positioned in a popular pocket of L8, the property benefits from easy access to the city centre, Baltic Triangle, Sefton Park and a wide range of local amenities and transport links. Its combination of size, layout and location makes it an attractive option for buyers seeking space, convenience and long-term value. This home suits a wide range of buyers. Additional features include luxury vinyl flooring and a large lounge window which floods the lounge with natural light and has beautiful views over the garden and part of Princes Park lake. The building itself is rich in character, forming part of the original Bellerive school which was newly developed 6 years ago Outside there is a well maintained, peaceful, garden area, which borders Princes Park lake. A peaceful residential street, with 5 minutes walking distance to Lark Lane and Sefton Park. A short 5-10 minute bus ride to the Georgian quarter and city centre. For cyclists, a short cycle through Princes Park and along Princes Road cycle path brings you to the Georgian Quarter. Plenty of green spaces from the door step. Set on the second floor of a well-kept residential building, this impressive two bedroom apartment on Windermere Terrace, L8 offers generous living space and a layout that will appeal to a wide range of buyers — from first-time purchasers to those seeking a larger, more comfortable apartment in a thriving city fringe location. The development enjoys an enviable position with Princes Park and Lark Lane right on the doorstep, providing immediate access to beautiful green space, independent cafés, restaurants and a vibrant cultural scene. The building itself is rich in character, forming part of the former Bellerive School, a feature that lends the development a unique sense of history and charm. It is also particularly well suited to those downsizing from a house, with several residents — including the current owner — having made the same transition. Converted and newly developed around five years ago, the apartment is ready to move straight into, requiring no further work. The interior features luxury vinyl flooring for both style and practicality, while a large window in the main living area floods the space with natural light and offers impressive views. The property opens into a spacious hallway that sets the tone for the generous proportions throughout. At the heart of the home is a bright and expansive open plan kitchen, living and dining area, designed for modern living with clearly defined zones for relaxing, dining and entertaining. The kitchen is fully equipped with integrated appliances, including a dishwasher and washer dryer, ensuring convenience from day one. Both bedrooms are well-proportioned, with the principal bedroom offering a notably generous footprint. The second bedroom is versatile and can comfortably accommodate a small double bed, making it ideal as a guest room, home office or nursery. A contemporary bathroom sits off the hallway, finished in a clean, neutral style to suit a variety of tastes. Practicality is further enhanced by inhouse storage, including the electric heater cupboard, with ample space for buyers to add additional storage solutions if desired. Positioned in a popular pocket of L8, the property benefits from easy access to the city centre, Baltic Triangle, Sefton Park and a wide range of local amenities and transport links. Its combination of size, layout and location makes it an attractive option for buyers seeking space, convenience and long-term value. results.summary: A BEAUTIFULLY PRESENTED TWO/THREE BEDROOM SEMI-DETACHED HOME ON LIVERPOOL ROAD, LYDIATE, OFFERING THOUGHTFULLY DESIGNED LIVING SPACES, INCLUDING A SPACIOUS LOUNGE, STUNNING KITCHEN, SEPERATE DINING AREA AND A VERSATILE SITTING ROOM/ GROUND FLOOR BEDROOM THREE ALL TO THE GROUND FLOOR, TWO FURTHER BEDROOMS AND BATHROOM TO THE FIRST FLOOR AND A SOUTH-FACING REAR GARDEN. THIS PROPERTY PROVIDES COMFORTABLE AND ADAPTABLE ACCOMMODATION, IDEAL FOR THOSE SEEKING MODERN CONVENIENCE IN A DESIRABLE LOCATION. Step inside this charming semi-detached home on Liverpool Road, where modern design meets practical living. From the welcoming porch, you are led into a spacious lounge, enhanced by an open staircase creating an airy feel. The heart of the home is a beautifully executed kitchen, flowing seamlessly into a perfectly formed dining area with French doors opening to the garden, an additional sitting room offers versatile space for various needs and could be a thrid bedroom. Upstairs, two comfortable bedrooms, including one with a built-in wardrobe, are served by a stylish bathroom featuring marble tiled flooring and a rainfall shower. Outside, the property boasts off-street parking for two cars and a carefully maintained, south-facing rear garden, perfect for enjoying sunny days. This home offers a wonderful opportunity to embrace a convenient lifestyle in Lydiate. Porch 1.44m x 1.22m (4'8" x 4'0") Enter through a Composite front door with feature glass and leaded panels into a welcoming porch, complete with uPVC double glazed windows and a wooden floor. A wooden door with etched glass panels leads into the lounge. Upstairs, the first floor hosts two well-proportioned double bedrooms, offering comfortable accommodation with flexibility for sleeping space, a home office or guest room. The home also benefits from allocated parking, adding everyday convenience for homeowners and visitors alike. Located close to local shops, amenities and transport links, the property also sits within reach of schools within catchment (subject to confirmation), making it well placed for day-to-day living and commuting across Liverpool and surrounding areas. results.summary: Nestled within a highly sought-after residential area of Formby, Merseyside, this impressive four-bedroom detached house presents a unique opportunity for discerning buyers. Priced at £595,000, this substantial property, spanning approximately 1847 square feet, beautifully combines the timeless elegance of its 1930s origins with thoughtfully integrated modern features, creating a truly inviting family home. Upon arrival, a good-sized driveway and well-maintained front garden lead to an open porch, setting the tone for the character within. Step inside and be greeted by a spacious, grand entrance hall, bathed in natural light, which immediately conveys a sense of warmth and history. This welcoming space provides a beautiful introduction to the rest of the home, hinting at the quality and charm that lies beyond. The accommodation is thoughtfully spread over three floors, offering versatile living spaces. The ground floor features Three generous reception rooms, perfect for both formal entertaining and relaxed family living. These rooms retain much of their original character, providing comfortable and stylish environments. The heart of the home is complemented by a well-appointed kitchen, designed to cater to modern family needs. Ascending to the upper floors, you will find four well-proportioned bedrooms, ensuring ample space for family and guests. The property benefits from three bathrooms, providing convenience and luxury, particularly for a busy household. Each room throughout the house showcases a harmonious blend of traditional architectural details and contemporary finishes, ensuring comfort without compromising on style. One of the standout features of this delightful home is its secluded south-facing rear garden. Accessible via patio doors from one of the reception rooms, this beautifully maintained, generous outdoor space offers a private oasis for relaxation, al fresco dining, and family activities. The south-facing aspect ensures an abundance of sunlight throughout the day, making it an ideal spot for enjoying the warmer months. Formby itself is renowned for its picturesque coastline, vibrant community, and excellent local amenities, including highly regarded schools, independent shops, and convenient transport links. This property's prime location ensures easy access to all that this desirable Merseyside town has to offer. This charming detached house is more than just a home; it is a lifestyle opportunity, offering space, character, and a superb location. Viewing is available immediately by appointment and is highly recommended to fully appreciate the unique appeal and extensive features of this exceptional property. results.summary: UNIQUE Extended FREEHOLD DETACHED Bungalow – Close to Freshfield Station & Formby Beach This unique and substantially extended three-bedroom detached bungalow occupies a desirable location within easy reach of Freshfield railway station and the beautiful Formby beach, offering an opportunity for buyers seeking spacious single-level living in a highly sought-after coastal setting. The property has been significantly improved by the current owners, combining stylish modern finishes with generous living space and excellent future potential. The accommodation briefly comprises an inviting entrance hall leading into a spacious and elegant lounge, featuring striking marble flooring, a feature fireplace, and bespoke cut-glass double doors which create a stylish and impressive focal point. There is a separate fitted kitchen and a dedicated dining room, ideal for entertaining and family living. From the dining room, doors open into a bright and sunny conservatory, added in 2015, which enjoys pleasant views over the garden. The property offers three well-proportioned double bedrooms, including a generous principal bedroom with ensuite bathroom and dressing room area, creating a comfortable and private retreat. Two further double bedrooms are served by the main bathroom although the current gym space could be an additional bathroom. Externally, the bungalow stands on a good-sized plot with a large west-facing rear garden, perfect for enjoying afternoon and evening sun. To the front there is driveway parking and access to a garage. Further enhancing the appeal, the property already benefits from planning permission for a loft conversion. The loft space is boarded, has electricity installed, and is accessed via a pull-down ladder, offering excellent potential to create additional accommodation (subject to any necessary consents). results.summary: The Property Set along Beresford Road, this mid terrace family home offers a traditional layout with flexible living space and plenty of potential. Arranged over two floors, it is a home that suits everyday living while offering scope to personalise and make your own. Step inside through the entrance hall, which leads into the front facing dining room. This is a welcoming space that works well for family meals, entertaining or as a second reception room if preferred. From here, the layout flows through to the rear lounge, creating a comfortable living area to relax and unwind at the end of the day. The fitted kitchen sits to the rear of the property and offers storage and worktop space for daily cooking. An inner hall leads through to the ground floor bathroom, keeping the layout practical and easy to navigate. Upstairs, the first floor provides three well proportioned bedrooms, offering flexibility for family life, guests or working from home. Each room is arranged off the landing, making good use of the available space. Outside, the property benefits from a rear courtyard, providing a low maintenance outdoor area that is ideal for seating, potted plants or enjoying some fresh air without the upkeep of a larger garden. Located in a well established part of Liverpool, this is a home that offers space, character and convenience. A solid choice for families, first time buyers or investors looking for a practical layout in a popular area. results.summary: Enjoying a prime location on South Barcombe Road in the highly sought-after suburb of Childwall, L16, is this stunning three bedroom semi detached residence, proudly presented to the sales market by appointed agents Move Residential. The property boasts an attractive frontage exuding kerb appeal, and offers generous living proportions which have been finished to an impeccable standard throughout, promising to make an enviable future home for a very lucky family. Entering via the porch, you are greeted into the property by an inviting entrance hall, leading through to two spacious and beautifully presented reception rooms, each providing welcoming spaces for relaxing and entertaining. The front lounge is awash with light courtesy of a bay window, whilst the rear sitting room enjoys a feature fireplace and sliding doors offering seamless access into a generous and meticulously maintained orangery which provides a delightful light-filled setting for enjoying family mealtimes and hosting guests. Continuing through you will find a stylish kitchen featuring a range of fitted base and wall units, complementary worktops providing plentiful surface space and a selection of sleek integrated appliances. Complete with a breakfast bar, this provides a social setting for casual dining and cooking in company. Concluding the extensive ground floor is a contemporary style shower room boasting a walk-in shower unit. The property continues to impress as you ascend to the first floor, where you will discover two generously sized double bedrooms along with a well-proportioned single room, each finished to an excellent standard, featuring attractive wood style flooring and fitted wardrobes throughout. Accompanying the sleeping accommodation and adding the finishing touch to the interior of this wonderful home is a deluxe three-piece family bathroom suite. Externally, the property is further enhanced by an expansive and lovingly maintained rear garden which provides an outdoor oasis for the whole household to enjoy. A neatly manicured lawn offers plenty of room for recreational activities, whilst a smartly flagged patio area presents a serene setting for al-fresco dining and entertaining. To the front, a driveway provides ample off-road parking and there is a storage room accessed via an electronic roll shutter garage door. Childwall offers excellent transport links for commuters via the M62, which starts and ends in Bowring Park. Broadgreen railway station offers regular services to Liverpool City Centre, Manchester, Wigan and St Helens, while the famous Childwall Five Ways links drivers to all areas of the City. For your free time, Bowring Park boasts the first municipal golf course in England, as well as the award winning National Wildflower Centre and plenty of open space. Childwall Woods meanwhile offers 39 acres of Local Nature Reserve to explore. Schools include Bishops Eton Primary School, the King David Schools and Childwall Sports College, as well as the Liverpool Hope University campus. results.description: The Property Situated on the ever-popular Deanland Drive, Liverpool, L24 1WA, this stunning three-bedroom semi-detached home has been finished to an exceptional standard throughout, offering stylish, turnkey living ideal for modern family life. Upon entering the property, you are welcomed into a bright and inviting hallway which provides access to a generously sized downstairs WC. To the right, the beautifully presented lounge offers a warm and relaxing retreat, recently enhanced with a contemporary log burner, bespoke designer radiators, and a media wall, creating a perfect focal point for cosy evenings in. To the rear of the property, the home truly comes into its own with a superb open-plan kitchen diner. Recently installed and designed with both style and functionality in mind, this impressive space features a central island and integrated appliances, providing the ideal setting for entertaining guests or enjoying family meals. The seamless layout and high-quality finish make this the heart of the home, with high-quality porcelain tiled flooring fitted throughout the whole ground floor. Upstairs, the impeccable presentation continues with newly fitted carpets throughout, air conditioning for added comfort, and a fresh, modern family bathroom finished to an excellent standard. There are three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a superb master bedroom complete with its own en suite shower room. Externally, the property benefits from landscaped gardens to both the front and rear, a converted garage offering versatile additional space with air conditioning, and off-street parking. This is a truly outstanding home where no detail has been overlooked, offering stylish interiors, practical living space, and a high-quality finish both inside and out. Outside Externally, the property is just as impressive. The former garage has been cleverly converted to provide a versatile space, half workshop and half storage, ideal for those working from home or requiring additional practical space. The rear garden has been immaculately landscaped, featuring attractive paved seating areas and porcelain tiles surrounding the artificial lawn for low-maintenance enjoyment all year round. results.summary: Sefton View - a truly remarkable family home. Tucked away off Trevor Drive, just a stone’s throw from Moorside Park, this exceptional home offers the perfect combination of privacy, space, and lifestyle. Ideally positioned for families wishing to access Forefield Primary or Chesterfield High, it’s a home that instantly feels welcoming and effortlessly liveable. This property has been extended over the years to create a truly expansive family residence, blending character, comfort, and contemporary finishes. Approach the property via private electric gates to a spacious driveway and detached garage with power, framed by a beautifully rendered exterior. Step inside the porch and into the reception hallway, where stunning herringbone LVT flooring and subtle design details set the tone for the standard of craftsmanship throughout. To the right, a versatile reception room, currently a music room, could serve as a home office, cosy lounge, or formal sitting room, offering flexibility to suit the changing needs of a modern family. To the left, ground floor bedroom 5, with its original parquet flooring and charming bay window, provides an ideal space for teenage or elderly living, or as the current owners enjoy it, a playroom or additional reception area. This level is completed by a practical bathroom and separate WC. The heart of the home is the full-width open-plan family living space at the rear - a true showstopper. Refurbished just 18 months ago, it features a Wren kitchen with specially sourced quartz worktops, integrated appliances, and a perfectly levelled floor with herringbone detail throughout. A remote-controlled fire in the media wall creates a cosy focal point for winter evenings, while floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors invite the summer sun in and frame spectacular views over the South-facing garden. Whether it’s weekend brunches, evening entertaining, or simply relaxing with the family, this space feels both luxurious and completely liveable. A separate utility room ensures practicality without compromising style. Upstairs, the split-level landing opens onto an impressively spacious first floor. To the front, two double bedrooms with fitted wardrobes are complemented by a charming window seat, perfect for reading or quiet reflection. To the rear, another double bedroom and the main family bathroom provide additional space, while the primary suite spans the full width of the house, offering a spacious bedroom, dressing room, and luxurious ensuite shower room - a private sanctuary for parents. Outside, the South-facing rear garden is a true extension of the home, designed for both relaxation and play. Composite decking, a pergola, astro lawn, planter borders, and generous space make it perfect for children to play, family barbecues, or simply enjoying the sunshine in privacy. From early morning coffee basking in the sun to cosy winter evenings by the fire, 1 Sefton View offers a lifestyle as impressive as its footprint. With excellent school catchment, parks nearby, and beautifully proportioned living spaces, this is more than just a house - it’s a home where memories are made. A rare opportunity for families seeking space, style, and a prime location, all tucked away in a quiet and private setting, yet close to everything you need. A note from the seller: “What I love most about our home is the bright kitchen–living space, where large sliding doors open wide to create a seamless flow between indoors and out. It transforms the house into a warm, welcoming place for entertaining family and friends. Whether you’re cooking inside or relaxing on the sunny deck, you can always keep an eye on the children as they play outside, which makes it feel connected and secure.” EPC Rating: D Read full description COUNCIL TAX Band: D PARKING Yes GARDEN Private garden ACCESSIBILITY Ask agent Energy Performance Certificate Utilities, rights & restrictions Sefton View, Crosby, L23 Open map Street View My places Stations Schools Add an important place to see how long it'd take to get there from our property listings. __mins driving to your place Check how much you can borrow Get an instant, personalised result: Show sellers you’re serious Secure viewings faster with agents No impact on your credit score Get a Mortgage in Principle Powered by Extension potential Broadband speed Property sale history Recently sold & under offer See similar nearby properties

results.summary: Karen Parks Sales and Lettings are pleased to offer for sale this beautifully extended and modernised four bedroom semi detached family home spanning over three floors. This is the perfect turn key property and offers an abundance of living space and four excellent sized bedrooms. The front of the property is gated with a large driveway providing off road parking for a number of cars, entering through doors into a spacious hallway on the ground floor. This comprises of a lounge, a snug/playroom, WC and expansive open plan kitchen-diner family room opening onto the garden through bi-fold doors and situated off here is a utility room. The first floor has a master bedroom with ensuite shower room and walk in dressing room/wardrobes, a further two excellent sized double bedrooms and a family bathroom with separate bath and shower. Leading up to the second floor is the forth bedroom/cinema room which is a large space with ensuite shower room. There are gardens to the rear of the property. The house is situated close to local Primary and Secondary schools making it conveniently located for families, it is also just a short walk to the Pinewoods and beach, and local shops, cafe and hairdressers. It is also within walking distance of Formby station and a bus route. The property is sold as seen and offered for sale WITH NO ONWARD CHAIN. Accommodation - Ground Floor - Hallway - Spacious hallway with under stairs storage cupboard containing a water tank. There is access into all rooms and double glass doors opening into open plan kitchen-family room. Snug/Office - 3.55 x 3.15 (11'7" x 10'4") - Situated at the front of the property this room could either be used as a snug, playroom or office for those who work from home. There is a double glazed box bay window. Lounge - 4.82 x 3.65 (15'9" x 11'11") - The lounge has a media wall with space for a TV and a built in fireplace as a focal point to the room. There is a double glazed box bay window. Open Plan Kitchen-Diner Family Room - 10.06 x 8.75 (33'0" x 28'8") - The extended open plan-kitchen-diner family room is perfect for entertaining guests and familing living and is a very expansive space. There are bi-folds opening up into the garden as well as four velux windows allowing an abundance of light to flow in. There is a large central island providing plenty of worktop space, room for bar stools, cupboards and drawers for storage and an integrated sink. There are a row of wall and base units with space for a large fridge-freezer and there is an integrated oven and grill. Utility Room - 2.65 x 2.20 (8'8" x 7'2") - The utility room has a sink with double glazed window above with obscured glass. There are built in cupboards and shelving for storage, the boiler is located in here, space for a dryer and plumbing for a washing machine. Wc - WC with hand wash basin with cupboard below. First Floor - Landing - The first floor landing has a full length double glazed window allowing plenty of light to flow in. Bedroom 1 - 5.27 x 3.25 (17'3" x 10'7") - The master bedroom has a double glazed window, one radiator and access into the ensuite and dressing room. Into Dressing Room - 3.85 x 3.05 (12'7" x 10'0") - The master bedrooms opens up into the dressing room which has a built in dressing table, built in shelving and rails providing plenty of storage. There is a middle unit with a glass top with pull out drawers on either side. There is one radiator and a double glazed window. Ensuite - 2.03 x 1.55 (6'7" x 5'1") - The ensuite has a walk in shower with two shower heads, WC, hand wash basin with cupboard below, double glazed window with frosted glass and a towel radiator. Bedroom 2 - 4.30 x 3.61 (14'1" x 11'10") - The second bedroom has built in double bunk beds, built in wardrobes and drawers for storage, one radiator and a double glazed window looking over the rear garden. Bedroom 3 - 4.15 x 3.65 (13'7" x 11'11") - The third double bedroom has built in bunk beds with a double and single bunk, a built in dressing table and wardrobe, one radiator and a double glazed box bay window with window seat. Bathroom - 3.10 x 2.86 (10'2" x 9'4") - The spacious family bathroom comprises of a large walk in shower with two shower heads, free standing bath with shower head attachment, WC, twin sink unit, TV built into the wall, towel radiator and double glazed window. Second Floor - Landing - Bedroom 4/Cinema Room - 9.80 x 6.10 (32'1" x 20'0") - This room is an excellent size and could either be used as a fourth double bedroom or alternatively a cinema room with media wall with space for a TV and feature fireplace. There is a door leading into some eaves storage, there are three radiators and three double glazed windows. Ensuite Shower Room - 3.17 x 1.85 (10'4" x 6'0") - The ensuite has a wet room shower with two shower heads, hand wash basin, WC and towel radiator. results.description: Karen Parks Sales and Lettings are pleased to offer for sale this beautifully extended and modernised four bedroom semi detached family home spanning over three floors. This is the perfect turn key property and offers an abundance of living space and four excellent sized bedrooms. The front of the property is gated with a large driveway providing off road parking for a number of cars, entering through doors into a spacious hallway on the ground floor. This comprises of a lounge, a snug/playroom, WC and expansive open plan kitchen-diner family room opening onto the garden through bi-fold doors and situated off here is a utility room. The first floor has a master bedroom with ensuite shower room and walk in dressing room/wardrobes, a further two excellent sized double bedrooms and a family bathroom with separate bath and shower. Leading up to the second floor is the forth bedroom/cinema room which is a large space with ensuite shower room. There are gardens to the rear of the property. The house is situated close to local Primary and Secondary schools making it conveniently located for families, it is also just a short walk to the Pinewoods and beach, and local shops, cafe and hairdressers. It is also within walking distance of Formby station and a bus route. The property is sold as seen and offered for sale WITH NO ONWARD CHAIN. Accommodation - Ground Floor - Hallway - Spacious hallway with under stairs storage cupboard containing a water tank. There is access into all rooms and double glass doors opening into open plan kitchen-family room. Snug/Office - 3.55 x 3.15 (11'7" x 10'4") - Situated at the front of the property this room could either be used as a snug, playroom or office for those who work from home. There is a double glazed box bay window. Lounge - 4.82 x 3.65 (15'9" x 11'11") - The lounge has a media wall with space for a TV and a built in fireplace as a focal point to the room. There is a double glazed box bay window. There are bi-folds opening up into the garden as well as four velux windows allowing an abundance of light to flow in. There is a large central island providing plenty of worktop space, room for bar stools, cupboards and drawers for storage and an integrated sink. There are a row of wall and base units with space for a large fridge-freezer and there is an integrated oven and grill. Utility Room - 2.65 x 2.20 (8'8" x 7'2") - The utility room has a sink with double glazed window above with obscured glass. There are built in cupboards and shelving for storage, the boiler is located in here, space for a dryer and plumbing for a washing machine. Wc - WC with hand wash basin with cupboard below. results.summary: Available to Cash Buyers Only, this three-bedroom mid-terraced home offering strong investment potential, requiring modernisation throughout with two reception rooms, generous room sizes and rear garden, ideally located close to local amenities, schools and transport links.by. Positioned within a well-established residential area, this three-bedroom mid-terraced home presents a strong opportunity for investors or buyers seeking a project with clear scope to add value. Requiring modernisation throughout, the property offers generous room proportions, a traditional layout and excellent potential to reconfigure or upgrade in line with current market expectations. The accommodation opens via a porch into a central hallway, leading through to two well-sized reception rooms. The front living room benefits from a large window allowing for good natural light, while the separate dining room to the rear provides a flexible space for family living or could be opened up to create a more contemporary open-plan layout, subject to the usual consents. The kitchen is positioned to the rear of the property and offers ample length and footprint for redesign, with direct access out to the garden, making it well suited for extension or reconfiguration to create a more modern kitchen-diner environment. To the first floor, the property offers three bedrooms, including two comfortable doubles and a third single room which could function equally well as a home office or nursery. The shower room is also located on this level and, while functional, would benefit from updating to maximise appeal and value. The layout is practical and consistent with similar homes in the area, providing a solid foundation for refurbishment. Externally, the property benefits from a rear garden which is mainly laid to lawn with a patio area, offering scope for landscaping to create an attractive outdoor space. The rear aspect is not directly overlooked, adding to the appeal for future occupiers. On-street parking is available to the front. The property is situated within a popular and convenient part of the city, offering easy access to a wide range of local amenities including supermarkets, shops and everyday services. There are several well-regarded primary and secondary schools within close proximity, making the area attractive for families and supporting long-term rental demand. The location is well connected, with nearby road links providing straightforward access into the city centre and surrounding areas, while regular public transport services offer reliable commuting options. For those seeking outdoor space, there are a number of nearby parks and green areas within easy reach, contributing to the overall appeal of the location. A previous survey has identified potential structural movement within the kitchen extension, with cracking noted to the wall. The surveyor has advised that remedial works may be required, which could include underpinning or removal/rebuild of the extension. The property is therefore considered suitable for cash buyers only. Enjoying an enviable location in the West Derby area, a short walk from excellent primary and secondary schools and Alder Hey Children’s Hospital, bars and eateries. A well maintained semi detached home that offers a traditional and contemporary practical layout that is perfect for modern day family living. First the hallway will welcome you through to the front lounge then off into the rear sitting room, with log bunting stove, which in turn leads into the conservatory overlooking the garden. The property is currently let at £750 per calendar month, delivering an approximate 10% net yield, making it an attractive option for both new and experienced investors seeking strong rental returns. This major infrastructure project is expected to increase accessibility, create new employment opportunities, and further drive demand for both rental property and residential living in the district. Often described as a "hidden gem" of Liverpool, the Baltic Triangle has evolved from its historic industrial port roots into one of the city's most dynamic neighbourhoods. Today it is home to a thriving community of independent businesses, creative studios, restaurants, and entertainment venues. The district attracts young professionals, entrepreneurs, creatives, musicians, and students, all drawn to its distinctive character, vibrant atmosphere, and striking red-brick warehouse architecture where historic charm meets modern regeneration. Regeneration Driving Future Growth Liverpool is benefiting from significant regeneration and infrastructure investment across the city. Major developments include the Liverpool Waters, a transformative project delivering five new waterfront neighbourhoods and effectively doubling the size of the city-centre waterfront. results.summary: Nestled on Carriage Close in the picturesque Hale Village, L24, is this magnificent six bedroom detached residence, proudly showcased to the sales market courtesy of appointed agents Move Residential. This property boasts a characterful frontage exuding kerb appeal, and offers a wealth of versatile and generously proportioned living space arranged over three floors which has been thoughtfully designed to meet the needs of modern living. The interiors have evidently been finished to the very highest specifications, exuding a sense of opulence and elegance throughout. Available for sale with no onward chain, this unique residence promises to make a truly exceptional forever home for a family seeking luxury living within a peaceful village location. An inviting entrance hall greets you into the property, leading through to a spacious family lounge which has been beautifully finished in a tasteful décor featuring plush carpeting, presenting a welcoming space to relax and unwind. The lounge flows seamlessly into a light-filled conservatory and continuing through you will find a dining room which enjoys a set of French doors providing access out to the garden and flooding the space with natural light, offering a delightful setting for enjoying family mealtimes and entertaining guests. At the heart of the home is an immaculately presented open plan kitchen dining and living space which is complete with a range of stylish fitted base and wall units, complementary worktops providing plentiful surface space, and a selection of sleek integrated appliances. With ample room to accommodate both a sitting and dining area, this presents the ultimate setting for social living, perfectly suited to enjoying quality family time and hosting on a larger scale. Continuing through you will find a striking orangery which is illuminated in daylight, offering a further space for entertainment or leisure where views of the garden can be enjoyed. Concluding the extensive ground floor is a well-equipped utility room and convenient WC. The property continues to impress as you ascend to the first floor, where you will discover four generously sized double bedrooms, each finished to an impeccable standard, with the master further enjoying the added luxury of a walk-in-wardrobe. The two primary bedrooms benefit from contemporary style ensuites, and serving the remaining bedrooms is a deluxe three-piece family bathroom suite featuring a free-standing bathtub. A sumptuous lounge offers access up to the second floor, where you will find the two final bedrooms, completing the interior of this remarkable residence. Externally, the property is further enhanced by an expansive rear garden, which provides a fantastic outdoor space for the whole household to enjoy, surrounded by mature greenery borders which offer privacy and seclusion. A vast neatly manicured lawn provides plenty of room for recreational activities whilst a raised decking area offers a serene setting for al-fresco dining and entertaining, complete with a sunken hot tub. To the front, a driveway provides ample off-road parking and a double garage offers additional storage space. results.summary: Arnold and Phillips are delighted to bring to the market this well-presented five-bedroom detached home located along Stonechat Drive in Maghull, positioned within a popular residential setting that continues to appeal to families and buyers seeking a modern home that is both practical and comfortable to live in. The property has been maintained to a very good standard throughout, offering a layout that works well for everyday family life while still providing clearly defined spaces to relax, entertain, and spend time together. What stands out when considering this home is the straightforward usability of the space; each room feels well balanced in size and purpose, and the overall layout has a natural flow that many buyers look for when searching for a long-term family property. Approaching the home, the frontage presents a neat and tidy first impression, with off-road parking positioned to the front of the property providing convenient day-to-day access for homeowners and visitors alike. Alongside this sits a small front garden area which softens the overall look of the property and gives a pleasant separation from the street. Entry into the home leads into a welcoming hallway space that immediately gives a sense of the home's well-kept condition. From here, access is provided to the main ground floor rooms, allowing for a layout that feels both practical and easy to navigate. The integrated garage is also accessible internally, something many buyers appreciate for storage, bikes, tools, or even the potential for future conversion depending on requirements and the necessary permissions. The lounge sits separately from the main kitchen area, offering a comfortable and more private space within the home. The proportions of the room allow for a full suite of furniture without feeling overcrowded, making it a room that works well for quieter evenings, family film nights, or simply somewhere to step away from the busier parts of the house. Having a dedicated lounge is often something buyers value, particularly in homes where open-plan kitchen spaces are used more actively throughout the day. Towards the rear of the property is the kitchen and dining area, arranged in an open layout that naturally becomes the centre of daily activity. The kitchen itself has a modern feel and is arranged in a way that provides a good amount of workspace and storage, making it suitable for both everyday cooking and hosting when needed. The dining area sits comfortably within the same space, allowing for a proper table and chairs where family meals or social occasions can take place without feeling squeezed in. The connection between kitchen and dining space makes this area particularly adaptable, whether that means busy weekday mornings or relaxed evenings with friends and family. From here, access leads directly into a separate utility room which is a feature that often proves invaluable in day-to-day living. Having a dedicated space for laundry appliances and additional storage helps keep the main kitchen area clear and organised, particularly in a busy household. Upstairs, the first floor continues the theme of practical family living, offering four well-proportioned bedrooms. Each room provides comfortable space for furnishings and personalisation, meaning they can easily adapt to a range of uses depending on a buyer’s needs. Whether used as children's bedrooms, guest accommodation, or even a home office, the flexibility here is clear. The main bedroom benefits from its own en suite, offering an added level of privacy and convenience that many buyers actively look for in modern homes. The remaining bedrooms are served by the family bathroom, which is well positioned to be easily accessible from across the landing and supports the needs of a growing household. Externally, the rear garden provides a fully enclosed outdoor space that feels secure and manageable, something particularly appealing for families with children or pets. The patio area sits just off the back of the house, creating a natural spot for outdoor seating and casual meals during warmer months, while the lawned section offers space for play, gardening, or simply enjoying time outside without the maintenance demands of a larger garden. The overall design strikes a good balance between usable outdoor space and practicality, ensuring the garden remains enjoyable rather than overwhelming to maintain. Stonechat Drive sits within a well-regarded part of Maghull, an area that has long been popular with families thanks to its combination of residential calm and everyday convenience. The town itself offers a wide range of local amenities including supermarkets, independent shops, cafes, and essential services, meaning most day-to-day needs are easily accessible. There are also several well-regarded schools within the surrounding area, which is often a key consideration for buyers looking to settle in the community for the long term. For commuters, Maghull benefits from reliable transport connections including nearby train stations offering routes towards Liverpool and surrounding areas, along with good road links that make travelling further afield straightforward. Green spaces and local parks are also within easy reach, providing opportunities for walks, outdoor activities, and family time close to home.
