results.summary: On the border of Little Crosby and Ince Blundell, this handsome 1930s home sits proudly on a generous corner plot, full of charm, character and beautifully considered upgrades throughout. Set behind a gated driveway, the property immediately feels private and established, with plenty of parking to the front and a further driveway leading to a detached garage at the rear. The outside space is a real highlight - a south-facing garden that enjoys the sun well into the evening, with a generous lawn, patio area and additional space to the side, ideal for families, entertaining or simply unwinding. Step inside and the tone is set from the outset. The porch opens into a truly impressive hallway - wide, welcoming and rich in original detail. The restored parquet flooring has been brought back to life, complemented by wall panelling, circular feature windows and beautifully replicated double glazed leaded lights that stay true to the home’s 1930s heritage. It’s a space so generous the sellers even have a couch here - which instantly gives that warm, homely feel. The front lounge is elegant and inviting, centred around a bay window with plantation shutters (still under warranty), a parquet-framed wooden floor and a feature fireplace. To the rear, a second reception room offers a more relaxed setting, complete with a log burner - perfect for cosy evenings - and flows seamlessly through oak partition doors into the extension. Currently used as a home office, this versatile space could easily serve as a formal dining room or playroom, with new patio doors opening directly onto the garden. The breakfast kitchen is well-appointed and practical, leading through to a separate utility room and WC - a valuable addition for busy family life, offering extra workspace and storage. Upstairs, the principal bedroom mirrors the charm of downstairs with its bay window and matching shutters. Two further well-proportioned bedrooms complete the first floor, along with a stylish family bathroom featuring a freestanding bath and separate shower. The home has been thoughtfully improved in recent years, including a new composite front door, upgraded double glazing (with stained glass detailing to the hallway), new patio doors, internal oak doors, updated bathroom and utility windows, new flooring and carpets, refreshed fencing and gates, full redecoration and external painting in 2025. The detached garage has also had electricity installed, opening up exciting potential as a workspace, studio or even a garden bar. Beyond the property itself, the location is a real draw. With easy access to Little Crosby village, Blundell Park, plus Formby in one direction and motorway access in the other, as well as excellent transport links, reliable bus routes and some of Sefton’s most sought-after schools, it’s a setting that balances convenience with a strong sense of community. Neighbours are long-standing and welcoming, and the area has a genuine pride and warmth that’s hard to find. A characterful, flexible and truly homely property, perfectly suited to modern family life while retaining everything that makes a 1930s home so special. A note from the seller: “One of our favourite spots is sitting on the comfy chair in the study, reading and looking onto the garden with a cuppa! The kitchen diner is also a really sociable space when entertaining.” EPC Rating: D Read full description COUNCIL TAX Band: E PARKING Yes GARDEN Private garden ACCESSIBILITY Ask agent Energy performance certificate - ask agent Utilities, rights & restrictions Southport Road, Thornton, L23 Open map Street View My places Stations Schools Add an important place to see how long it'd take to get there from our property listings. __mins driving to your place Check how much you can borrow Get an instant, personalised result: Show sellers you’re serious Secure viewings faster with agents No impact on your credit score Get a Mortgage in Principle Powered by Renovation potential Broadband speed Property sale history Recently sold & under offer See similar nearby properties

results.summary: Century 21 Liverpool South is delighted to introduce to the sales market a three bedroom semi-detached family home situated within a quiet cul-de-sac in Hunts Cross, L25. The property, which is in need of modernisation and improvement, but is priced accordingly, is offered with no onward chain and would be an ideal purchase for first time buyers and investors alike. The property briefly comprises; porch, entrance hallway, bright spacious lounge with sliding doors through to an open plan dining – kitchen area with base units. To the first floor are three well-proportioned bedrooms and a bathroom. Externally there is a paved front driveway and to the rear is an established garden laid to lawn with mature shrubs and patio area. The immediate area is well established and served by a wealth of amenities including excellent shopping facilities at nearby Hunts Cross, Woolton Village and Speke Retail Park which offers a wide choice of local and superstore shopping. There is a great choice of leisure and entertainment amenities including a selection of bistros, restaurants and bars, open space and recreation facilities including those at the popular Camp Hill & Allerton Towers. The area is renowned for its selection of schooling covering all age ranges and nearby Speke Boulevard & Menlove Avenue form part of Liverpool’s main routes connecting with a network of major road and motorway links. results.summary: The site is located on the corner of Allerton Road and Hillfoot Road (A562) in the district of Woolton, South Liverpool. Woolton lies approx. 6 miles south east of Liverpool City Centre. The subject is irregular in shape and is currently undeveloped and comprises a mixture of woodland, open grassed areas and areas with shrubs. Access to the site is via the entrance to Woolton Acre Care Home, accessed off Allerton Road. The proposed development on the subject site has planning permission for 9 significant detached dwellings. The entire site is placed to the market comprising 4.97 hectares (12.27 acres). The area that has planning permission comprises the northern part of the site closest to the junction of Hillfoot Road and Woolton Road which comprises 3.04 hectares (7.50 acres). results.summary: Nestled within the highly sought-after coastal town of Formby, Merseyside, 'The Old Parsonage' presents a truly unique opportunity to acquire a magnificent Grade II Listed Georgian detached residence. Dating back to the 1770s, this charming property is steeped in history, offering a rare blend of period elegance and versatile modern living, all set within an expansive 1.23-acre plot of beautifully maintained, picturesque grounds. This beautiful family home is set over circa 3643 square feet. Upon arrival, the property immediately captivates with its timeless Georgian architecture and impressive frontage. The residence has been meticulously presented, retaining its historical integrity whilst offering comfortable and enriched living spaces. Spanning three impressive floors, the versatile accommodation is perfectly suited for a growing family or those who appreciate generous proportions and distinct living zones. The ground floor welcomes you with a series of four spacious reception rooms, each exuding character and charm. These versatile spaces can be adapted to suit various needs, whether as formal dining rooms, cosy sitting areas, a dedicated study, or a vibrant family room. High ceilings, original features, and large windows allow natural light to flood the interiors, creating an inviting and airy atmosphere throughout. The heart of the home, the kitchen, offers ample space for culinary pursuits and informal dining, seamlessly connecting to the other living areas. Ascending to the upper floors, you will discover five generously proportioned bedrooms, providing ample private retreats for all residents. The two well-appointed bathrooms serve these bedrooms, offering both convenience and comfort. Each room within 'The Old Parsonage' tells a story, enriched with Traditional features that speak to its long and distinguished past, from intricate cornicing to original fireplaces. Externally, the property truly excels. The expansive 1.23 acres of land provide a stunning backdrop to this historic home. The picturesque grounds are a haven of tranquillity, featuring mature trees, manicured lawns, and perhaps even hidden pathways, offering endless opportunities for outdoor enjoyment, entertaining, or simply relaxing amidst nature. The sheer size of the plot ensures privacy and a sense of seclusion, a rare commodity in such a desirable location. There is also an additional stretch of land that the property owns on a long leasehold interest which isn't highlighted in the marketing, adjacent to the boundary of 48 Green Lane on the right hand side as you look at the house. Formby itself is renowned for its stunning coastline, vibrant community, and excellent local amenities, including highly regarded schools, boutique shops, fine dining establishments, and convenient transport links. The combination of this prime location and the unique character of 'The Old Parsonage' makes it an exceptionally appealing proposition for discerning buyers. This charming detached Georgian residence is more than just a house; it is a piece of history, offering a lifestyle of elegance and serenity. At £1,850,000, 'The Old Parsonage' represents a significant investment in a truly exceptional property. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the grandeur, history, and potential this magnificent home has to offer. results.summary: A 667 square ft one bedroom, first floor apartment within Retirement Security's Priory Court, a retirement development in Huyton, L36. This well-presented accommodation comprises entrance hall with two storage cupboards, fully equipped kitchen with integrated fridge/ freezer, oven and hob, living room with feature fireplace, master bedroom with bay window and large built wardrobe including further bult in storage, plus a level access wet room. The property is located close to the lift and boasts a 990 year lease extension. On the outskirts of the pleasant village of Huyton, Priory Court is an independent retirement setting of 44 spacious apartments and a collection of bright communal spaces, all at your disposal. Bask in the luxuries of a higher-service retirement development with 24-hour staff who are always on site and available to help and support you wherever needed. There is also a trustworthy team of Housekeeping Assistants who look after all shared spaces, and complete a weekly 90 minute cleaning of your dwelling! Relax in the Owner’s Lounge and catch up with familiar faces over a morning coffee or afternoon tea and take part in the lively social schedule the Court offers: from films, scheduled speakers, musical entertainment, and armchair yoga classes to quizzes and raffles, there is always something to get involved with. The Owner’s Dining Room is the perfect place to unwind over a warming 3-course meal that is prepared fresh and in-house, with popular bacon and sausage butties being served for breakfast on most Tuesdays. Unwind in the Hobbies Room, a quieter space where you can enjoy a variety of past times like arts and crafts, cards, board games and whist. Priory Court is surrounded by vibrant greenery, with trees sheltering you from the surrounding area, and plants beautifully positioned around the grounds. Within the UK, Retirement Security was one of the first to establish Independent Retirement Communities and, since its inception in 1983, has continued to be a trail blazer for nearly 40 years. The company was established to offer affordable homes within a happy and secure environment carefully designed for ease of access, in which owners could enjoy their retirement and thrive in an active supportive community, but where they could also protect and keep control of their hard-earned finances through running their own communities - Communities for owners run by owners. That remains true today in each of Retirement Security's 32 courts across England and Wales. It is important to note that a significant proportion of the Service Charge relates to items which the prospective purchaser is responsible for in their present home, such as building insurance, building maintenance, gardening, and domestic help. The lease provides that a transfer premium is payable to Retirement Security on resale of a property. The maximum premium payable is 3% of the sale price depending on the length of time an Owner has lived at the property. Further information is available from the Court Manager. results.summary: Montclair Drive is widely regarded as one of the most desirable residential addresses in Liverpool, forming part of a well-established neighbourhood predominantly comprising attractive inter-war semi-detached and detached homes. This charming period property offers spacious and well-balanced accommodation, blending traditional character with the practicality required for modern family living. The accommodation is arranged over two floors. On entering the property, a vestibule porch leads into an elegant reception hall featuring a half-turn staircase rising to the first floor. To the front of the property is a substantial sitting room with a bay window, while to the rear there is a generous family and dining room with French doors opening onto the rear garden, providing an excellent space for entertaining and everyday family life. The large kitchen is well equipped and benefits from a Velux window which allows an abundance of natural light. Located just off the kitchen is a convenient ground floor WC and shower room. To the first floor, the landing provides access to four well-proportioned bedrooms, including a spacious principal bedroom with a bay window. A large family bathroom completes the accommodation on this level. The property further benefits from gas central heating and double glazing throughout. Externally, the home is set within well-established gardens and benefits from a substantial driveway providing ample off-street parking. results.summary: Occupying a generous corner plot and surrounded by attractive woodland, this exceptional four-bedroom detached home offers a rare opportunity to acquire a property that combines spacious living with a wonderfully peaceful natural setting. With driveway parking for approximately four to five vehicles and a substantial double garage, the home immediately impresses upon arrival. Upon entering, you are welcomed by a bright and spacious entrance hall, enhanced by a stylish oak styled staircase with contemporary glass panelling, creating an elegant first impression and allowing natural light to flow throughout the space. To the right of the hallway is a generously proportioned lounge, beautifully presented and featuring a modern media wall with a built-in electric fire, providing a cosy yet sophisticated focal point. Double doors lead through to the dining room, creating the option of open-plan living while still allowing the spaces to be separated when desired. The dining room enjoys patio doors that open directly onto the rear garden, allowing an abundance of natural light and providing the perfect setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen is well-appointed with a breakfast bar and an excellent range of cupboard space, offering both practicality and style. Conveniently, the kitchen has a large under stairs cupboard, perfect for all your storage needs. Further patio doors provide additional access to the garden, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor living. A separate utility room sits just off the kitchen and benefits from its own external door, offering added convenience for day-to-day living. Completing the ground floor accommodation is a downstairs W/C. Externally, the property benefits from a large double garage which, while currently non-integral, is attached to the house and offers significant potential. Subject to the necessary permissions, it could easily be incorporated into the main home via the kitchen or converted into a variety of uses such as a home office, gym, salon, or even a self-contained annex, making it ideal for those running a business from home or requiring additional flexible living space. To the first floor are four well-proportioned bedrooms, all of which comfortably accommodate furniture, with even the smallest room being large enough for a small double bed. The principal bedroom is particularly bright and airy, benefiting from fitted wardrobes and a modern en-suite shower room. Two further double bedrooms also include fitted wardrobes, while the fourth bedroom—currently utilised as a home office—features fitted units and offers versatile use. The family bathroom is impressively sized and finished to a high standard, featuring a freestanding bath alongside a separate walk-in shower, as well as underfloor heating, creating a luxurious and relaxing space. The outdoor space is equally impressive. The generous south-facing rear garden offers excellent privacy and enjoys a beautiful natural backdrop, with woodland bordering the side of the property. The garden is a haven for wildlife and regularly attracts a variety of birds and animals, including wrens, long-tailed tits, robins, woodpeckers, squirrels and hedgehogs, creating a truly tranquil environment. Directly opposite the property is a protected pond, enclosed by hawthorn hedging and home to the protected great crested newt. As a conservation area, the pond is not accessible to the public, helping to preserve the peaceful surroundings and natural habitat. Uniquely, this property is one of only two homes on the estate built by a different developer, resulting in a distinctive house type with a noticeably larger footprint and plot than many neighbouring properties. The overriding appeal of this home is its remarkable sense of peace and privacy—an idyllic setting where the predominant sounds are birdsong and the gentle rustle of wildlife moving through the surrounding woodland. results.summary: Investment Opportunity - Baltic Triangle, Liverpool Currently Tenanted - £750 PCM | Approx. 10% Net Yield An excellent opportunity to acquire a tenanted residential property in Liverpool's vibrant Baltic Triangle, one of the city's fastest-growing districts. The property is currently let at £750 per calendar month, delivering an approximate 10% net yield, making it an attractive option for both new and experienced investors seeking strong rental returns. Prime Baltic Triangle Location Located in the popular Baltic Market area, this property benefits from its position in a neighbourhood undergoing significant transformation. A £100 million railway station - Liverpool Baltic - is scheduled to open in 2027, dramatically improving connectivity to the area. This major infrastructure project is expected to increase accessibility, create new employment opportunities, and further drive demand for both rental property and residential living in the district. Often described as a "hidden gem" of Liverpool, the Baltic Triangle has evolved from its historic industrial port roots into one of the city's most dynamic neighbourhoods. Today it is home to a thriving community of independent businesses, creative studios, restaurants, and entertainment venues. The district attracts young professionals, entrepreneurs, creatives, musicians, and students, all drawn to its distinctive character, vibrant atmosphere, and striking red-brick warehouse architecture where historic charm meets modern regeneration. Why Invest in Liverpool? Liverpool's property market offers a compelling combination of heritage, regeneration, and strong investment performance. The city continues to deliver solid rental yields and consistent capital growth, making it a top choice for property investors across the UK. Property prices remain highly competitive compared with other major UK cities: - Around 44% lower than the England and Wales average - Approximately 30% more affordable than Manchester - Up to 65% cheaper than London This affordability creates an accessible entry point for investors, alongside strong long-term growth potential. Regeneration Driving Future Growth Liverpool is benefiting from significant regeneration and infrastructure investment across the city. Major developments include the Liverpool Waters, a transformative project delivering five new waterfront neighbourhoods and effectively doubling the size of the city-centre waterfront. The wider waterfront regeneration has attracted over £5.5 billion in investment, including: - 315,000 sq m of new office space - 53,000 sq m of hotel and conference facilities - A new cruise liner terminal - Extensive retail and leisure amenities These developments continue to boost employment, population growth, and housing demand across Liverpool. results.summary: Berkeley Shaw Real Estate present this three-bedroom semi-detached house is offered for sale in a sought-after residential area of Maghull. Neutrally decorated throughout, it provides a practical layout well suited to families. The ground floor features two reception rooms. The main reception room benefits from large windows, a fireplace, and views over the garden, with direct access outside, creating a bright and comfortable living space. The second reception room is an open-plan dining area, ideal for everyday family use and entertaining. The kitchen enjoys good natural light and also offers access to the garden. Upstairs, the master bedroom includes built-in wardrobes, providing useful storage. A further double bedroom also benefits from built-in wardrobes, while the third bedroom is a single. The bathroom is fitted with a heated towel rail and there is a separate WC. Externally, the property includes a garden, parking, and a single garage. Maghull is well regarded for its local amenities, including nearby shops, supermarkets, and cafés, particularly around Central Square and along Westway. Families benefit from access to nearby schools in the area. Local parks and green spaces, such as Maghull Square and surrounding playing fields, provide opportunities for leisure and recreation. Public transport links are a key advantage. results.summary: Set back from the road in a courtyard development of traditional barns and farmhouse, this Grade II listed barn conversion in the sought after area of Formby is ideally located for local amenities and excellent commuter links. The ground floor features a generous drawing room, kitchen-diner, and dining room. A further reception room provides opportunity for a snug, home office or additional bedroom with an adjacent w.c. Upstairs, you'll find four well-proportioned bedrooms along with a spacious family bathroom. The master bedroom enjoys the added convenience of its own private en suite. The garden includes a feature summer house, in a private corner spot. Generous parking facilities make everyday living more practical, with space for two vehicles to the side and further parking available at the front. The property also benefits from an integrated single garage. Situated beside open countryside and close to the stunning Formby coast, this property is perfect for those seeking scenic living with local amenities such as shops, cafes, and restaurants nearby. results.summary: The Property This home offers a rare blend of space, style, and convenience, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers or families seeking a welcoming environment. With its extended layout and modern upgrades, it’s ready to move into and enjoy immediately. Located in the popular Stoneycroft area, this three-bedroom semi-detached property on Eccleshill Road combines a modern layout with generous living space and a good-sized garden—perfect for growing families, first-time buyers, or those wishing to add their own personal touch. The bright entrance hall leads to two separate reception rooms and an extended kitchen/dining space. The front lounge provides a cosy yet contemporary setting for relaxing or entertaining, while the rear reception room offers flexibility as a family room, dining space, or playroom. The extended kitchen includes a large cooking area and a breakfast bar, ideal for casual dining and busy family life. Upstairs, the home offers three well-proportioned bedrooms—two doubles and a single—suited to family living, guests, or home working. A modern three-piece bathroom provides a fresh, functional space. The boiler and central heating system were replaced in 2023, offering efficiency and peace of mind. Externally, the rear garden is enclosed and private, creating a safe space for children, pets, or outdoor entertaining. A brick-built outhouse provides excellent storage, with space for laundry appliances. While the property does not include a driveway or garage, its location more than makes up for this. Close to local schools, shops, and excellent transport links—including easy access to the M62, Bootle, Broadgreen, and Liverpool city centre—this home is well placed for both commuting and family life. With its extended layout and modern upgrades, it’s ready to move into and enjoy immediately. Located in the popular Stoneycroft area, this three-bedroom semi-detached property on Eccleshill Road combines a modern layout with generous living space and a good-sized garden—perfect for growing families, first-time buyers, or those wishing to add their own personal touch. The bright entrance hall leads to two separate reception rooms and an extended kitchen/dining space. The front lounge provides a cosy yet contemporary setting for relaxing or entertaining, while the rear reception room offers flexibility as a family room, dining space, or playroom. The extended kitchen includes a large cooking area and a breakfast bar, ideal for casual dining and busy family life. Upstairs, the home offers three well-proportioned bedrooms—two doubles and a single—suited to family living, guests, or home working. A modern three-piece bathroom provides a fresh, functional space. The boiler and central heating system were replaced in 2023, offering efficiency and peace of mind. Externally, the rear garden is enclosed and private, creating a safe space for children, pets, or outdoor entertaining. A brick-built outhouse provides excellent storage, with space for laundry appliances. While the property does not include a driveway or garage, its location more than makes up for this. Close to local schools, shops, and excellent transport links—including easy access to the M62, Bootle, Broadgreen, and Liverpool city centre—this home is well placed for both commuting and family life. results.summary: An incredibly spacious four bedroom double-fronted detached character home on one of Crosby’s most sought-after roads, Bonnington Avenue. Finished to an exceptional standard throughout, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a home where the scale, quality and attention to detail are immediately clear from the moment you arrive. A generous resin-bound driveway with EV charging point provides off-road parking for two cars to the front. Step through the charming porch with its characterful tiled floor and into a welcoming hallway where beautiful parquet flooring immediately sets the tone. This continues into the elegant front sitting room, complete with bay window and fireplace. To the rear, the home opens into a superb extended family living space, perfectly designed for modern life. The lounge flows seamlessly into the dining area, with parquet flooring, bespoke cabinetry either side of the fireplace and floor-to-ceiling glazing around the patio doors flooding the space with natural light. What was once the garage has been cleverly converted to create a cosy family snug that opens directly into the kitchen - a fantastic sociable space complete with island, breakfast bar, separate utility room and downstairs WC. Upstairs, even the landing offers a real sense of space. There are four generous double bedrooms, with the primary suite occupying what was originally the footprint of two rooms, now reconfigured to create a dressing room leading into the bedroom, along with a stylish ensuite with walk-in shower. A beautiful family bathroom with freestanding bath and a separate WC complete the first floor. Outside, the landscaped rear garden is immaculate and designed for easy living, with an artificial lawn, contemporary horizontal slatted fencing and a composite decked terrace complete with awning and outdoor heater. The garden enjoys a sunny South facing aspect and is not overlooked thanks to the allotments beyond. A fully sheltered and secure covered port runs the full length of the property, providing excellent additional storage. Looking to get your children into Valewood Primary School? Bonnington Avenue is a literal stone’s throw away and comfortably within the catchment, while also being conveniently located for many of Crosby’s other highly regarded schools. Homes finished to this standard, on roads as popular as this, rarely come to market. Get in touch to reserve your slot! A note from the seller: “The thing I love most about our home is the living/dining area. It’s where we all come together as a big family, playing games, sharing dinner, and spending real quality time with each other. In the summer we open the patio doors and spill out onto the decking, enjoying the fresh air when the weather’s nice. And when it gets a little cooler, we pull out the awning, switch on the heater, and sit back to enjoy the last of the sun with a little bit of music playing in the background.” Read full description COUNCIL TAX Band: F PARKING Yes GARDEN Private garden ACCESSIBILITY Ask agent Energy performance certificate - ask agent Utilities, rights & restrictions Bonnington Avenue, Crosby, L23 Open map Street View My places Stations Schools Add an important place to see how long it'd take to get there from our property listings. __mins driving to your place Check how much you can borrow Get an instant, personalised result: Show sellers you’re serious Secure viewings faster with agents No impact on your credit score Get a Mortgage in Principle Powered by Renovation potential Broadband speed Property sale history Recently sold & under offer See similar nearby properties

results.summary: Welcome to this beautifully presented three-bedroom detached property, offered for sale by Find Your Eden and situated in the highly sought-after L18 postcode. This extended and deceptively spacious home blends elegant interiors with flexible living, offering a rare opportunity to acquire a property that is both stylish and practical. Set behind a private driveway, the home boasts immaculately maintained gardens, generous living areas, and a thoughtfully extended layout that suits both family living and single-level convenience. Inside, you'll find a warm and welcoming entrance hall, multiple reception rooms, and a stunning open-plan kitchen with modern finishes and bi-folding doors leading to the garden. The ground floor includes two well-appointed bedrooms (one currently used as an office), a contemporary shower room, and a flexible annex-style layout ideal for guests or multigenerational living. Upstairs, the impressive master suite offers excellent storage, a characterful dressing area, and a quiet office, perfect for working from home. Externally, the property continues to impress with a private rear garden and composite decking seating areas. With quality finishes throughout, including decorative oak joinery, stylish bathrooms, and modern heating systems, this home is ready to move straight into. Located in a desirable residential area close to excellent schools, amenities, and transport links, this exceptional home offers the perfect balance of comfort, space, and location. Located on the desirable Druidsville Road in the heart of Calderstones, this property enjoys one of South Liverpool's most sought-after residential addresses. Known for its leafy streets, well-maintained homes, and close-knit community feel, Calderstones offers the perfect blend of suburban tranquillity and city convenience. Just a short stroll away is the renowned Calderstones Park, a stunning 94-acre green space featuring botanical gardens, lakes, a café, and the iconic Mansion House, making it ideal for families, dog walkers, and outdoor enthusiasts alike. The area is well-served by a range of excellent local amenities, including independent shops, cafés, and restaurants along Allerton Road and Woolton Village, both of which are nearby. Supermarkets, gyms, and healthcare facilities are all easily accessible. Families will appreciate the proximity to outstanding local schools and colleges, while commuters benefit from excellent transport links. The property is within easy reach of Liverpool South Parkway and offering direct connections to the city centre and beyond. Access to major road networks such as Queens Drive and M62 further enhances connectivity. Council Tax Band: D Tenure: Freehold Entrance Hall 4.09m x 2.66m Step into a welcoming and elegantly finished entrance hall, accessed through striking double composite doors with decorative frosted glass panels. The space features rich wood-effect laminate flooring, detailed oak architrave, and matching skirting boards. A staircase with an oak balustrade rises to the first floor, while a gas central heating radiator adds comfort. The hallway sets a stylish tone and provides seamless access to the rest of the property. Open Plan Living & Dining Area 6.79m x 3.92m This bright and inviting space is enhanced by elegant design details, including wood-effect laminate flooring and decorative skirting and architrave. A feature gas fireplace with a marble surround and hearth creates a cosy focal point. A front-facing double-glazed bay window fills the room with natural light, while side-facing patio doors open directly onto the outdoor seating area. A gas central heating radiator ensures comfort throughout the seasons. Kitchen 5.23m x 3.19m A generous and stylish kitchen that perfectly blends modern design with functionality. Featuring sleek laminate flooring, an extensive range of fitted wall, base, and drawer units, and polished quartz worktops, this kitchen is built for both everyday use and entertaining. A chrome sink with mixer tap sits beneath a window, and a central island includes integrated gas hobs, a mix of quartz and wood worktops, and built-in storage. Integrated appliances include a double electric oven, microwave, fridge/freezer, and wine cooler. Double-glazed bi-fold doors to the side provide plenty of natural light and open out to the rear patio and garden. The kitchen also offers access to a well-equipped utility room. Utility Room 2.14m x 1.67m A practical utility space fitted with wall and base units, a contemporary worktop, and plumbing for both a washing machine and dishwasher. It also houses the Worcester boiler (installed in 2021) and features a rear-facing frosted double-glazed window and recessed downlighters. Lounge 5.27m x 3.49m Located at the heart of the home, this spacious front lounge is filled with natural light from a large bay window. Finished with detailed skirting and architrave, it also includes two gas central heating radiators. The room provides internal access to an annex-style area, adding further flexibility. Living Room 4.46m x 3.54m Another generously proportioned front-facing reception room, this living room is also flooded with light from a bay window. Features include decorative skirting and architrave, a modern gas central heating radiator, and access to Bedroom Three and the adjoining shower room, ideal for guest accommodation or multigenerational living. Shower Room 3.54m x 1.95m Modern and well-appointed, the shower room comprises a three-piece suite with tiled flooring and partially tiled walls. The suite includes a close-coupled WC, a wall-hung wash hand basin with built-in storage and matte black mixer tap, and a walk-in shower with chrome fittings and a glass screen. Additional features include a matte black heated towel radiator and a side-facing double-glazed window. Bedroom 3 4.31m x 2.9m This ground floor double bedroom features a front-facing bay window, wood-effect laminate flooring, a gas central heating radiator, and decorative skirting and architrave. Store Room/Workshop 2.96m x 1.7m Currently used as a workshop, this versatile space is accessed from the rear garden via double-glazed sliding doors and offers potential for a range of uses. First Floor Landing 2.68m x 2.67m The landing continues the home’s tasteful decorative theme with matching skirting boards and architraves. With a double glazed window to the front. This area provides access to the remaining bedrooms and the family bathroom. results.summary: Rowland Homes presents The Tatton B - boasting an open plan kitchen/dining/family room with french doors opening to the garden, a separate utility room and downstairs WC. Upstairs there's an en-suite to the master bedroom, 3 further double bedrooms and a family bathroom. Plot 77 - The Tatton B - Available at £421,995 - **Home of the week** A stunning 4 bedroom detached home with detached garage Plot 80 - The Tatton B - Available at £409,995 Waddicar Rise, Chapel Lane, Melling L31 1ED Show Homes open Mon 10.30am - 4.30pm Thurs 12pm - 5pm Fri 10.30am - 5pm Sat & Sun 10.30am - 5.30pm Welcome to Waddicar Rise Waddicar Rise is a prestigious development of quality two, three, four and five bedroom new homes and sits in balance amidst this thriving village community. Rowland is committed to creating a popular and vibrant environment, that embraces the local heritage, as well as serving the local residents by providing a select and distinctive range of mews style properties, along with semi-detached and detached homes. With a varied option of house styles on the development, the overall feel is of a community that has grown up over time, with a range of different architectural styles and features such as bay windows, porches, brickwork and other unique signature features. Each home benefits from a private garden to the rear, with spaces for parking at the front and the majority of properties having a single or detached garage. The interiors of the homes at Waddicar Rise display a dedication to contemporary design styling with the option to personalise your home (dependent on build stage). Every home benefits from quality fixtures and fittings, with kitchens containing the very latest brand-name integral appliances. Bathrooms benefit from designer sanitaryware, elegant tiling and a high specification. Whilst light and airy living areas boast natural light and modern open plan features, making the maximum use of space. Melling Less than nine miles from Liverpool city centre, the village of Melling is a traditional community whose roots go as far back as Anglo-Saxon times. Nowadays, Melling is a thriving village community with several shops, a primary school and a number of excellent pubs. In addition, Melling Tithe Barn is a popular community centre, that hosts a wide range of events and concerts. Conveniently situated close to both the M58 and M57, Melling is a little under nine miles from the heart of the historic city of Liverpool, which is rich in nautical and musical heritage, as well as featuring many museums and galleries. Liverpool also boasts an impressive array of shops, bars, restaurants and traditional pubs, as well as a vibrant city centre pedestrian area and riverside tourist attractions such as the Albert Dock and Maritime Museum. Closer to home, nearby Aintree (just three miles from Melling) offers a major retail park, as well as a supermarket, cinema and other leisure facilities. For days out, there are delightful local walks along the Leeds & Liverpool Canal, which passes through Melling village, whilst a little further afield, the Lancashire coast features the wonderful sand dunes and red squirrel reserve at Formby, as well as genteel Southport - and, further north, both Lytham St. Annes and Blackpool. Local motorways close to Melling link with the north-south M6, for fast access to Manchester, the Lake District, the Yorkshire Dales, the Trough of Bowland and the picturesque Ribble Valley. *Available on selected plots. results.summary: EXTENDED family home in a superb Formby location, offering generous accommodation across three floors and a WEST-FACING REAR GARDEN that enjoys the afternoon and evening sun. Positioned within easy reach of local schools, the train station and the village, this is a practical and well-placed home with excellent potential for the next owner. The accommodation begins with an ENTRANCE HALL with WC, leading through to a comfortable LOUNGE with feature fireplace and a SEPARATE DINING ROOM overlooking the rear garden with sliding doors opening outside. The KITCHEN sits to the rear of the property and connects well with the garden, providing a practical family layout. On the FIRST FLOOR there are THREE BEDROOMS together with a FAMILY BATHROOM, all arranged off the central landing. The property was further enhanced with a LOFT CONVERSION circa 2005, creating a spacious MAIN BEDROOM with EN-SUITE, offering a private top-floor retreat. Externally, the property benefits from OFF-ROAD PARKING and a GARAGE, together with a good-sized rear garden enjoying a WEST-FACING aspect. The dormer roof was replaced approximately three years ago, while the garage flat roof was renewed around five years ago, providing reassurance regarding key external works. Overall, this is a well-located extended home with flexible accommodation and plenty of potential, ideal for buyers looking to create a long-term family property in a sought-after part of Formby. results.summary: EXTENDED semi-detached family home offering around 1,200 sq ft of accommodation and positioned in a popular residential area of Lydiate, within easy reach of the Leeds & Liverpool Canal where scenic walks and welcoming canal-side pubs are part of everyday life. The property has been a cherished family home for over 40 years and now presents a fantastic opportunity for the next owner to create a modern family home in a well-connected and highly regarded location. The ground floor begins with an ENTRANCE HALL leading to a comfortable FRONT SITTING ROOM overlooking the front aspect. To the rear of the property is a spacious LOUNGE / DINING ROOM, extended and centred around a WOOD-BURNING STOVE, creating a warm and inviting living space with plenty of room for both relaxing and entertaining. The EXTENDED KITCHEN / DINER forms the natural heart of the home, offering excellent space for everyday family living and informal dining. Practical additions include a UTILITY ROOM and GROUND FLOOR WC, both useful features for modern family life and rarely found in homes of this style. Upstairs the property offers THREE DOUBLE BEDROOMS, all well-proportioned, together with a FAMILY BATHROOM. The MAIN BEDROOM benefits from an EN-SUITE, providing a comfortable private space. The house was significantly enhanced in the 1990s with both a DOUBLE-STOREY SIDE EXTENSION and a REAR EXTENSION, which has created the generous accommodation now on offer. Externally the property benefits from OFF-ROAD PARKING for two cars to the front and a good-sized WEST-FACING REAR GARDEN, ideal for enjoying afternoon and evening sunshine. With excellent access to local schools, public transport and Maghull Square, this is a well-located and spacious home with enormous potential. results.summary: Welcome to this exceptional duplex penthouse apartment within the iconic Albany Building, one of Liverpool city centre’s most prestigious and architecturally striking developments. This magnificent Grade II Listed landmark, located in the very heart of Liverpool, perfectly blends historic character with contemporary city living. Positioned in one of the city’s most desirable locations, residents enjoy immediate access to Liverpool’s Central Business District, making it an ideal home for professionals seeking both convenience and lifestyle. The surrounding area offers an outstanding selection of amenities, from stylish cafés and award-winning restaurants to vibrant bars, boutique shopping and cultural attractions. With the Liverpool waterfront, Liverpool ONE, and excellent transport connections all within easy reach, the property offers the very best of city living right on your doorstep. This chain-free duplex apartment offers spacious, well-designed accommodation. The lower level comprises two generous double bedrooms, including a superb master bedroom with en-suite shower room, along with a well-appointed main bathroom. Upstairs, the property opens into a spectacular open-plan living and kitchen space, where impressive floor-to-ceiling windows flood the room with natural light and create a bright, contemporary living environment. Sliding doors lead directly onto a substantial balcony, offering a fantastic outdoor space rarely found in city centre apartments. The modern, sleek kitchen is thoughtfully designed and features integrated appliances including an oven, hob and dishwasher. Residents of The Albany benefit from a range of premium on-site amenities, including secure allocated parking & 24-hour concierge. Combining historic elegance, contemporary living space and an unrivalled city centre location, this outstanding penthouse apartment offers a truly exceptional lifestyle opportunity in one of Liverpool’s most celebrated buildings. Hallway - The hallway is carpeted and leads to the bedrooms and bathrooms downstairs. It features a staircase rising to the upper floor, which houses the open-plan living area. Kitchen Diner/Living Area - 24'1" x 17'5" - This open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area is bright and spacious, measuring 7.3m by 5.3m. The room benefits from floor-to-ceiling windows and glass doors that open out onto a long balcony, flooding the space with natural light. The kitchen features a modern design with wood-effect cabinetry, integrated appliances, and tiled flooring, which contrasts with the warm wooden flooring in the living and dining sections. This is a fantastic space for entertaining or simply relaxing. Balcony - The balcony runs along the width of the living area and provides ample outdoor space with wooden decking and a metal railing. It overlooks the surrounding cityscape, offering an outdoor area for relaxation or entertaining. Bedroom 1 - 16'1" x 9'0" - The master bedroom measures 4.9m by 2.7m and offers a calm and neutral space with carpet flooring and soft lighting, creating a restful atmosphere. It includes an ensuite shower room with tiled walls and floor, a walk-in shower cubicle, a modern wall-mounted toilet, and a hand basin, all presented in light neutral tones for a clean finish. Bedroom 2 - 12'0" x 7'7" - The second bedroom is a comfortable size with neutral décor and carpet underfoot, making it a versatile space for guests or as a study. The room has a small window and is easily accessible from the hallway. Bathroom - The family bathroom is fully tiled in a neutral palette and includes a bath with shower overhead, a modern toilet, and a hand basin. It provides a clean and practical space adjacent to the bedrooms. Externally - Impressive development with secure intercom access, on site concierge and allocated parking. results.summary: Brought to the market by Atlas Estate Agents, this exceptional detached house at 35 Mersey Road, Aigburth, L17, offers a rare blend of historic charm and contemporary sophistication. The expansive reception room exudes refinement and warmth, with plush beige carpeting underfoot, a charming log burner, and striking beamed ceilings that celebrate the property’s character and heritage. results.summary: For Sale – Wellington Avenue, L15 Extended Four-Bedroom End-Terrace Home – Excellent Opportunity Situated on the ever-popular Wellington Avenue in L15, this substantial extended four-bedroom end-terrace property offers generous living accommodation across three floors. While the property would benefit from modernisation throughout, it presents an exciting opportunity for buyers to create a fantastic family home in a highly sought-after South Liverpool location. Upon entering the property, you are welcomed through a vestibule leading into a spacious entrance hall which provides access to the main ground floor accommodation. To the front of the property is a large living room, featuring a bay window and generous proportions, making it an ideal main reception space. Moving through the hallway, there are two additional reception rooms: a separate dining room and a family room, both offering flexible living and entertaining space. To the rear, the property benefits from an extended kitchen, providing good workspace and access to a ground floor WC, as well as access towards the rear of the property. The first floor offers three well-proportioned bedrooms. The principal bedroom benefits from its own en-suite shower room, while a family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms on this level. There is also an additional small kitchen/utility area on this floor, offering potential for reconfiguration depending on the buyer’s needs. Stairs continue to the second floor, where you will find a spacious loft-level room that could serve as an excellent guest bedroom, home office, or additional living space. Overall, the property offers excellent internal space and a versatile layout, with significant scope for renovation and modernisation. This property has recently had the roof replaced. Wellington Avenue is ideally located, offering easy access to a wide range of amenities. The vibrant Smithdown Road is just a short distance away, providing an excellent selection of restaurants, cafes, bars, and local shops. The property is also conveniently positioned for Sefton Park and Greenbank Park, perfect for outdoor leisure and family activities. The accommodation is thoughtfully arranged over two floors and briefly comprises; A welcoming reception hall leading into an attractive formal lounge with log-burning stove. To the rear, a light and airy open-plan dining room connects to a modern fitted kitchen, creating an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. The area is also well regarded for schooling, with a choice of schools catering for a range of age groups. Further benefits include convenient access to the Otterspool promenade, excellent road connections to surrounding areas, and Liverpool John Lennon Airport, which is located a short drive away. results.summary: Century 21 Liverpool South is delighted to offer for sale a two bedroom, second floor apartment situated within the very sought after area of Calderstones, South Liverpool. Offered with no onward chain, the accommodation, which is in need of some modernisation, briefly comprises; communal entrance, hallway, bright and spacious lounge, fitted kitchen, two well proportioned bedrooms and family bathroom. The property features double glazing and has electric heating throughout. Externally the front approach is set back from the road with beautifully maintained and manicured communal gardens to the front and rear. Furthermore, the property benefits from recently installed (2024) Dimplex electric wall heaters, and a new hot water cylinder, double glazing, and residential parking. The apartment would benefit from some upgrades such as bathroom, kitchen, windows, and decoration but is priced accordingly and a viewing is highly recommended to appreciate this popular development location, and the space the apartment has to offer. Calderstones is an extremely popular area of South Liverpool appealing to everyone from young professionals and families to retirees. Open green space includes the 94 acre Calderstones Park with a children's playground, ornamental gardens, a lake and a cafe, with Sefton and Greenbank Parks both close by in L17. Allerton Road is in close proximity and is a thriving local high street which has retained a traditional butchers, fishmongers and green grocers and, together with Rose Lane, offers some of the best bars and restaurants outside of the City Centre. A large Tesco store is located off Mather Avenue, with several Tesco Express in the immediate vicinity. Transport links into and out of the City are excellent, with Queens Drive connecting the area to the rest of the City and both John Lennon Airport and the M62 can be reached by car in less than 10 minutes. results.summary: Proudly brought to the market by Atlas Estate Agents, this beautifully presented end-of-terrace home on the ever-popular Avondale Road in Wavertree offers stylish, well-planned accommodation arranged over two floors, perfectly suited to modern living. Upon entering the property, you are welcomed by a cosy and characterful reception room. The space is enhanced by elegant chevron flooring and a bright bay window which fills the room with natural light, creating a warm and inviting setting ideal for relaxing or entertaining. To the rear of the property lies an impressive open-plan kitchen diner, created by thoughtfully opening up what was formerly a second reception room. This transformation has produced a generous and sociable living space that forms the true heart of the home. The contemporary kitchen is finished to a high standard and features sleek cabinetry alongside a central island breakfast bar — perfect for casual dining, morning coffee or gathering with family and friends. A convenient downstairs W.C. completes the ground floor. Upstairs, the property offers three comfortable, carpeted bedrooms, one of which benefits from a charming bay window that allows light to pour into the space. The accommodation is served by a modern family bathroom, stylishly appointed with a bath as well as a separate walk-in shower. Additional practical features include a boarded loft with a pull-down ladder, providing excellent storage space. Externally, the property enjoys a spacious rear courtyard — an ideal spot for outdoor dining, summer evenings, or simply enjoying a private outdoor retreat. On-street parking is available to the front of the property. Ideally situated just a few minutes from the much-loved Sefton Park, and within easy reach of local amenities, cafés and transport links, this delightful home presents a wonderful opportunity to acquire a thoughtfully updated property in a highly desirable South Liverpool location. results.summary: Modern Method of Auction Sale - Sale Agreed Price + Reservation Fee - Freehold Property - 4 Self Contained Flats We are delighted to offer this large semi-detached property, currently split into four separate, one bedroom flats, two with current sitting tenants and two vacant properties (basement and ground floor). Each flat comprises; entrance hall, separate bedroom, ample living space, a kitchen and a three piece bathroom suite. The property is to be sold with vacant possession and could bring in a handsome income for a new landlord with refurbishment throughout or perhaps someone wishing to convert this wonderful character property, back into a sole residential home. This method of auction requires both parties to complete the transaction within 56 days of the draft contract for sale being received by the buyers solicitor. This additional time allows buyers to proceed with mortgage finance. The buyer is required to sign a reservation agreement and make payment of a non-refundable Reservation Fee. This being 4.5% of the purchase price including VAT, subject to a minimum of £6,600.00 including VAT. The Reservation Fee is paid in addition to purchase price and will be considered as part of the chargeable consideration for the property in the calculation for stamp duty liability. Buyers will be required to go through an identification verification process with I AmSold and provide proof of how the purchase would be funded. A sample copy of the Reservation Agreement and terms and conditions are also contained within this pack. The buyer will also make payment of £349.00 including VAT towards the preparation cost of the pack, where it has been provided by I Am Sold. The property is subject to an undisclosed Reserve Price with both the Reserve Price and Starting Bid being subject to change. results.summary: Investment Opportunity - Baltic Triangle, Liverpool Currently Tenanted - £665 PCM | Approx. 9% Net Yield An excellent opportunity to acquire a tenanted residential property in Liverpool's vibrant Baltic Triangle, one of the city's fastest-growing districts. The property is currently let at £665 per calendar month, delivering an approximate 9% net yield, making it an attractive option for both new and experienced investors seeking strong rental returns. Prime Baltic Triangle Location Located in the popular Baltic Market area, this property benefits from its position in a neighbourhood undergoing significant transformation. A £100 million railway station - Liverpool Baltic - is scheduled to open in 2027, dramatically improving connectivity to the area. This major infrastructure project is expected to increase accessibility, create new employment opportunities, and further drive demand for both rental property and residential living in the district. Often described as a "hidden gem" of Liverpool, the Baltic Triangle has evolved from its historic industrial port roots into one of the city's most dynamic neighbourhoods. Today it is home to a thriving community of independent businesses, creative studios, restaurants, and entertainment venues. The district attracts young professionals, entrepreneurs, creatives, musicians, and students, all drawn to its distinctive character, vibrant atmosphere, and striking red-brick warehouse architecture where historic charm meets modern regeneration. Why Invest in Liverpool? Liverpool's property market offers a compelling combination of heritage, regeneration, and strong investment performance. The city continues to deliver solid rental yields and consistent capital growth, making it a top choice for property investors across the UK. Property prices remain highly competitive compared with other major UK cities: - Around 44% lower than the England and Wales average - Approximately 30% more affordable than Manchester - Up to 65% cheaper than London This affordability creates an accessible entry point for investors, alongside strong long-term growth potential. Regeneration Driving Future Growth Liverpool is benefiting from significant regeneration and infrastructure investment across the city. Major developments include the Liverpool Waters, a transformative project delivering five new waterfront neighbourhoods and effectively doubling the size of the city-centre waterfront. The wider waterfront regeneration has attracted over £5.5 billion in investment, including: - 315,000 sq m of new office space - 53,000 sq m of hotel and conference facilities - A new cruise liner terminal - Extensive retail and leisure amenities These developments continue to boost employment, population growth, and housing demand across Liverpool. results.summary: This well presented first floor two bedroom apartment offers modern, easy to maintain living within a popular and convenient development. Ideal for first time buyers, professionals or investors, the property combines a bright contemporary interior with practical features and secure parking. The accommodation is well laid out, with a generous principal bedroom that benefits from a small recessed area beside the window that lends itself well to use as a dressing space. The room is also served by its own three piece ensuite shower room comprising shower, wash basin and W.C. A second bedroom provides flexibility depending on needs, working equally well as a guest bedroom, nursery or home office. The standout feature of the apartment is the open plan living space. The main bathroom is finished in a modern style and fitted with a three piece suite including bath with shower over, W.C., wash basin and a heated towel rail. Additional benefits include storage heaters, secure bike storage within the development, and a gated allocated parking space. Located within Liverpool’s historic Georgian Quarter, this address enjoys a fantastic balance of character and convenience. Princes Park is only moments away, offering attractive green space for walks and recreation, while Liverpool city centre can be reached easily via nearby transport links. The popular Baltic Triangle and the independent cafés, restaurants and bars along Smithdown Road are also within easy reach, creating a vibrant and well connected place to live. The property holds an EPC rating of D and falls within Council Tax Band B. results.summary: A well presented 1163 square foot two bedroom retirement apartment available at Retirement Security's Blundellsands Classic, a development for the over 60's. Recently redecorated and boasting new carpets throughout the property comprises an entrance hall with storage, spacious sun-filled living room with multiple windows and feature fireplace, refitted fully equipped kitchen, master bedroom with built in wardrobes and access to an ensuite with level access shower, second bedroom with further built in storage and a separate bathroom. Are you looking to settle into a sophisticated, beautifully refurbished 19th-century hotel now acting as an exclusive retirement development with higher-quality service and independent living? Blundellsands Classic offers fifty-three bespoke apartments and nine bungalows, with occupiers embracing the Owner’s Lounge and Hobbies room where a host of activities are provided such as darts, indoor bowls, and whist - some even try a new look and utilise the in-house hair salon. The on-site catering team prepare and serve delicious meals in the Owner’s Dining Room, combining the luxury services of an RS property with the thriving community of Blundellsands Classic. Our housekeeping team provides cleaning assistance to your dwelling and the communal areas, and a gardener maintains our extensive grounds. There is also a reliable window cleaner who completes regular services on the entire building, ensuring the Court is always presented to the upmost standards. 24-hour on site staff create a supportive safety-net for all Owners, driving independent living with the constant, underlying reassurance of support when necessary. The Court is a scenic 10-minute walk from Crosby Beachfront, where you can bask in artist Anthony Gormley’s ‘Another Place’: 100 striking cast-iron human sculptures that are revealed in line with the tides’ flow. With countless local amenities surrounding the property and the train station a short 3-minute walk away, you have direct and easy access into Liverpool Centre or Southport Town Centre, and plenty of days out to be made! Local restaurants, supermarkets like Farmfoods, Sainsburys the Co-Operative and Iceland a short train journey away. Unique coffee shops and leisure shopping are within walking distance. Just nine miles away sits Formby National Trust and Formby Golf Club; both brilliant opportunities to soak up the sea breeze. Alternatively, visit Rimrose Valley, a nature reserve with an abundance of wildlife and known for its diverse bird watching. Blundellsands Classic truly is a remarkable retirement property located in an area thriving with possibilities, elevating the independent retirement experience for twenty-three rewarding years, and putting you first – run by Owners, for Owners. Providing a unique approach to independent retirement living, Retirement Security was established in 1983. We have continued to trail blaze for over 40 years with 32 Courts across England and Wales all offering a range of high-level services to make life easier. Our founder, Bob Bessell, committed to provide retirees with a wider selection of retirement options, ones that offered affordability, a secure environment and a supportive community, alongside retaining financial control – Courts ‘Run by Owners, for Owners’. These carefully designed properties bridge the gap between luxury retirement living and preserving your independence for as long as possible. It is important to note that a significant proportion of the Service Charge relates to items which the prospective purchaser is responsible for in their present home, such as building insurance, building maintenance, gardening, and domestic help. The lease provides that a transfer premium is payable to Retirement Security on resale of a property. The maximum premium payable is 3% of the sale price depending on the length of time an Owner has lived at the property. Further information is available from the Court Manager. results.summary: Ince Road - where countryside views meet refined family living. Set behind a handsome double-fronted façade, this five-bedroom detached home has been beautifully upgraded and functionally enhanced with a number of key structural improvements including a brand new roof with insulation and double glazing throughout. The home sits on an impressive 0.44-acre plot (approx) and enjoys a rare semi-rural outlook, with open views across the Livery and horses grazing beyond the garden boundary. It’s the kind of setting that feels wonderfully tucked away, yet remains within easy reach of Little Crosby, Formby, M57 and M58, and beyond. Inside, the ground floor is perfectly arranged for family life and entertaining alike, with five versatile reception rooms offering flexibility as needs change. The rear living room is generous and light-filled, with rich parquet flooring and double patio doors opening straight onto the rear terrace, seamlessly connecting indoors and out. A second, cosier sitting room provides a more intimate retreat, centred around an exposed brick fireplace and again opening to the garden through French doors. A third reception room again with parquet and a fireplace, works equally well as a formal dining room or sitting room, while the fourth room facing the front garden could optimally be utilised as a home office or playroom. Finally, a large fifth reception room with parquet flooring featuring the original leadlight bay windows serves as a formal sitting room or library. The current layout present enormous opportunity to combine living spaces. At the heart of the house is a thoughtfully upgraded kitchen, finished with bespoke Shaker-style cabinetry in soft neutral tones, slate worktops and a central island. Integrated appliances include Miele double ovens, a Neff hob and microwave, alongside a large country-style Belfast sink. A separate utility room adds everyday practicality, while a stylish ground floor WC completes the layout. Original Victorian parquet flooring runs through parts of the ground floor, currently partially carpeted, but offering excellent scope for restoration to create a beautiful, characterful finish throughout. Upstairs, the first floor hosts four generous double bedrooms and three bathrooms. The principal bedroom is a calm, spacious sanctuary with its own well-appointed ensuite, while a second double bedroom also benefits from ensuite facilities. The huge extended rear bedroom is over 24ft! A smart family bathroom with free standing bath, walk in shower, double sinks and sky lights is a true haven. With all rooms finished in neutral tones and plush carpets, you really can just move straight in! Rising to the second floor, the attic conversion is a real standout - a vast, light-filled fifth bedroom with vaulted ceilings, multiple skylights, fitted wardrobes and a dedicated desk area. Whether used as a main suite, teenage retreat or guest room, it’s an exceptionally flexible space. Outside is where this home truly shines. The south-facing rear garden is both expansive and beautifully curated, designed to make the most of long, sun-soaked days. A large reclaimed Yorkshire stone patio provides an elegant entertaining space, leading onto a sweeping lawn bordered by mature trees, hedging and established planting for privacy and year-round interest. There’s a gazebo and BBQ area for gatherings, a west-facing firepit spot for evenings as the sun sets, and mature apple, pear and nectarine trees offering seasonal produce. Families will love the thoughtful touches throughout the garden, from space for swings and a summer playhouse to a forest-themed play area with stepping stones and mud kitchen. Electricity is already connected to the far end of the garden, opening up easy potential for a future summer house, studio or workshop. To the front, a granite cobble sett driveway provides parking for 3–4 cars, framed by fencing and gated side access. Crucially, this is a home where all the big jobs have already been done. Recent improvements include a brand-new roof with insulation, new double-glazed windows to the upper floors, updated wiring, new water tank, smart heating controls, upgraded lighting throughout, security lighting and an ADT armed-response alarm system. Significant professional tree work and reinforced boundary fencing have further enhanced both light and privacy. The result is a house that offers total peace of mind, immediate comfort, and still leaves room for new owners to add their own stamp over time. A rare opportunity to secure a substantial family home with space, setting and soul - semi-rural living at its very best. results.summary: Sunday lunch at So-lo Restaurant. A walk along the Leeds Liverpool Canal. Then home to four acres of complete privacy behind your own gates. That’s everyday life at Jackson’s Bridge Farm on Pygons Hill Lane in Lydiate, postcode L31 4JE. A beautifully crafted country house just minutes from Aughton and Town Green, where village life, great food and open countryside all meet in one very special pocket of West Lancashire. Four acres. Total privacy. And the sort of house people move here for when they want countryside without disappearing into the middle of nowhere. Hidden behind hardwood electric gates at the end of Pygons Hill Lane, Jackson’s Bridge Farm sits within roughly four acres of beautifully landscaped grounds just moments from the Leeds Liverpool Canal. This is one of Lydiate’s premier homes, and a rare one at that. Built in 2008 using handmade York brick and a traditional slate roof, the house was designed to feel substantial from day one. Since then the current owners have carefully refined it, bringing everything up to a standard that feels quietly luxurious rather than showy. Inside, the house flows around a spectacular imperial ash staircase, rising through three storeys and setting the tone the moment you walk through the door. At the heart of the home sits a proper chef’s kitchen. Bespoke oak cabinetry, granite worktops, a central island, Belfast sink and range cooker, all looking out across the gardens and terraces. It’s the kind of kitchen where people naturally gather. Beyond that the living space opens up into a generous dining area and a beautiful lounge centred around a stone fireplace with wood burning stove. There’s also a large additional sitting room, currently used as a games room, with French doors straight out to the gardens. Altogether the house offers just over 4,000 square feet of living space, with four double bedrooms arranged over the upper floors. The principal suite enjoys dual aspects across the grounds, bespoke fitted wardrobes and a striking four piece en suite with freestanding bath. Two further bedrooms have their own en suites, while the fourth is served by a beautifully finished family bathroom. Underfloor heating runs through the ground and first floors, a fully integrated home entertainment system is wired throughout, and intercom entry with CCTV provides peace of mind. Everything here has been thought through properly. Step outside and the real magic of this home becomes obvious. The plot extends to around four acres, combining formal gardens, sweeping lawns and open land with potential for paddocks should the next owner want it. Indian stone terraces wrap around the house creating brilliant spaces for entertaining, summer evenings and long outdoor lunches. Mature planting frames the gardens beautifully, giving the entire property a sense of calm and privacy that is increasingly hard to find this close to Liverpool. A detached double garage sits neatly off the gravel forecourt, and previous planning permission has been secured for extensions to two elevations. For anyone wanting to create something even larger, the potential is already there (subject to the necessary consents). Yet the house already feels complete. The location is another reason people are drawn here. Pygons Hill Lane is a small private lane serving just three homes, tucked quietly alongside the Leeds Liverpool Canal. It’s peaceful, green and properly rural. But within minutes you’re in Aughton and Town Green, where life revolves around great food, good pubs and village living done properly. Sunday lunch at S -l Restaurant. Dinner at Moor Hall Restaurant or The Barn at Moor Hall. A midweek glass at Arthur's of Aughton. There are also brilliant country pubs dotted all around this pocket of West Lancashire, plus canal walks, countryside and cycling routes right on your doorstep. Families relocating here often have one eye on Scarisbrick Hall School, one of the region’s most respected independent schools, while commuters appreciate how quickly Liverpool can be reached from nearby Town Green station. And for buyers coming from South Liverpool or Cheshire, the appeal becomes even clearer. Because finding four acres and over 4,000 sq ft this close to Liverpool simply isn’t possible at this price point anywhere near Hale or Alderley Edge. Jackson’s Bridge Farm offers something increasingly rare. Space. Privacy. Proper countryside. But still close enough to great restaurants, good schools and city connections that everyday life remains wonderfully easy. For a private viewing or further information, contact Steph. Where Is Jackson’s Bridge Farm Located? Jackson’s Bridge Farm is located on Pygons Hill Lane in Lydiate, near Aughton and Town Green in West Lancashire, within easy reach of Liverpool. How Much Land Does The Property Have? The property sits within approximately four acres of private grounds including formal gardens and open land with potential for paddocks. What Schools Are Nearby? Scarisbrick Hall School, one of the North West’s most respected independent schools, is just a short drive away. results.summary: ‘Ranza’ sits proudly on the corner of St Michaels Road and Dowhills Road in the heart of Blundellsands. Dating back to 1926, this wonderful home is full of charm, character and original features. Step through the brightly painted red front door into the porch with its original quarry tiles, setting the tone for what lies beyond. The hallway is a truly impressive space - originally designed as the home’s dining hall - where an exposed brick fireplace surround hints at the roaring fires that would once have filled the room. The seller also advises that the original parquet flooring lies beneath the carpet. Off the hallway is a formal lounge with a bay window overlooking the large side garden. There is a dining kitchen with original servant bells and beautiful period cabinetry, alongside a formal dining room which opens into a bright sun room overlooking the south-facing garden. A utility room and downstairs WC complete the ground floor. To the first floor are four generous double bedrooms, three with fitted wardrobes. What were originally separate bathroom and WC rooms have been combined to create a spacious family bathroom, while the primary bedroom benefits from a hidden en suite shower room tucked behind a pocket door. Outside there is a detached garage and driveway accessed from Dowhills Road. The property enjoys three lawned garden areas with plenty of potential to create more private outdoor spaces if desired, along with several useful outbuildings.
